146.m: With nine they praised: the fathers were created, Aditi was the lady-overlord. With eleven they praised: the seasons were created, the seasonal [deities] were the overlords. / With thirteen they praised: the months were created, the year was the overlord. With fifteen they praised: princely power was created, Indra was the overlord.

146.s: saptada̱śabhi̍rastuvata grā̱myāḥ pa̱śavo̍'sṛjyanta̱ bṛha̱spati̱radhi̍patirāsīnnavada̱śabhi̍rastuvata śū̱drāryā asṛ̍jyetāmahorā̱tre adhi̍patnī āstām eka̍vim̐śatyāstuva̱taika̍śaphāḥ pa̱śavo̍'sṛjyanta̱ varu̍ṇo̱'dhi̍patirāsīt trayo̍vim̐śatyāstuvata kṣu̱drāḥ pa̱śavo̍'sṛjyanta pū̱ṣādhi̍patirāsīt
146.d: सप्तद̱शभि̍रस्तुवत ग्रा̱म्याः प̱शवो̍ऽसृज्यन्त̱ बृह̱स्पति̱रधि̍पतिरासीन्नवद̱शभि̍रस्तुवत शू̱द्रार्या असृ̍ज्येतामहोरा̱त्रे अधि̍पत्नी आस्ताम् एक̍विम्̐शत्यास्तुव̱तैक̍शफाः प̱शवो̍ऽसृज्यन्त̱ वरु̍णो̱ऽधि̍पतिरासीत् त्रयो̍विम्̐शत्यास्तुवत क्षु̱द्राः प̱शवो̍ऽसृज्यन्त पू̱षाधि̍पतिरासीत्
146.m: With seventeen they praised: domestic animals were created, Bṛhaspati was the overlord. With nineteen they praised: Śūdra and Ārya were created, day and night were the ladies-overlord. / With twenty-one they praised: single-hoofed animals were created, Varuṇa was the overlord. With twenty-three they praised: small animals were created, Pūṣan was the overlord.

146.s: pañca̍vim̐śatyāstuvatā̱raṇyāḥ pa̱śavo̍'sṛjyanta vā̱yuradhi̍patirāsītsa̱ptavi̍ṃm̐śatyāstuvata̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī vyai̍tā̱ṃ vasa̍vo ru̱drā ā̍di̱tyā a̍nu̱vyāya̍m̐sta e̱vādhi̍pataya āsan nava̍vim̐śatyāstuvata̱ vana̱spata̍yo'sṛjyanta̱ somo'dhi̍patirāsīdeka̍trim̐śatāstuvata pra̱jā asṛ̍jyanta̱ yavā̍ścā̱yavā̍ścādhi̍pataya āsan traya̍strim̐śatāstuvata bhū̱tānya̍śāmyanpra̱jāpa̍tiḥ para̱meṣṭhyadhi̍patirāsīt lo̱kaṃ pṛ̍ṇa̱ tā a̱syendrā̍ viśvā̍ḥ
146.d: पञ्च̍विम्̐शत्यास्तुवता̱रण्याः प̱शवो̍ऽसृज्यन्त वा̱युरधि̍पतिरासीत्स̱प्तवि̍ंम्̐शत्यास्तुवत̱ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी व्यै̍ता̱ं वस̍वो रु̱द्रा आ̍दि̱त्या अ̍नु̱व्याय̍म्̐स्त ए̱वाधि̍पतय आसन् नव̍विम्̐शत्यास्तुवत̱ वन̱स्पत̍योऽसृज्यन्त̱ सोमोऽधि̍पतिरासीदेक̍त्रिम्̐शतास्तुवत प्र̱जा असृ̍ज्यन्त̱ यवा̍श्चा̱यवा̍श्चाधि̍पतय आसन् त्रय̍स्त्रिम्̐शतास्तुवत भू̱तान्य̍शाम्यन्प्र̱जाप̍तिः पर̱मेष्ठ्यधि̍पतिरासीत् लो̱कं पृ̍ण̱ ता अ̱स्येन्द्रा̍ विश्वा̍ः
146.m: With twenty-five they praised: wild animals were created, Vāyu was the overlord. With twenty-seven they praised: heaven and earth went apart; the Vasus, Rudras, and Ādityas moved along with them, they were indeed the overlords. / With twenty-nine they praised: the trees of the forest were created, Soma was the overlord. With thirty-one they praised: creatures were created, the bright and dark fortnights were the overlords. / With thirty-three they praised: beings were appeased, Prajāpati the supreme was the overlord. / Fill the space; these all to Indra…

146.s:
(9) dhruvakṣitiḥ pañca
sajūṛ̍tubhistisraḥ
mūrdhā vayaḥ pañca
indrāgnī tisraḥ
146.d:
(9) ध्रुवक्षितिः पञ्च
सजूऋ̍तुभिस्तिस्रः
मूर्धा वयः पञ्च
इन्द्राग्नी तिस्रः
146.m: Dhruvakṣiti [has] five. Sajūrṛtubhiḥ [has] three. Mūrdhā vayaḥ [has] five. Indrāgnī [has] three. Āyurme [has] six. Mūrdhāsi [has] two. Āśuśca [has] two. Agnerbhāgaḥ [has] five. Ekayā [has] four. / Thirty-five [verses] in nine anuvākas. / Thus ends the fifteenth chapter in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

146.s:
āyurme ṣaṭ
mūrdhāsi dve
āśuśca dve
agnerbhāgaḥ pañca
ekayā catasraḥ
146.d:
आयुर्मे षट्
मूर्धासि द्वे
आशुश्च द्वे
अग्नेर्भागः पञ्च
एकया चतस्रः

147.s: agne̱ jātānpraṇu̍dā naḥ sapa̱tnānpratyajā̍tāñjātavedo nudasva adhi̍ no brūhi suma̱nā ahe̍ḷam̐sta̱vam̐ syā̍ma̱ śarma̍m̐stri̱varū̍tha u̱dbhau
147.d: अग्ने̱ जातान्प्रणु̍दा नः सप̱त्नान्प्रत्यजा̍ताञ्जातवेदो नुदस्व अधि̍ नो ब्रूहि सुम̱ना अहे̍ऌअम्̐स्त̱वम्̐ स्या̍म̱ शर्म̍म्̐स्त्रि̱वरू̍थ उ̱द्भौ
147.m: O Agni, repel our born rivals, and thrust away the unborn, O Jātavedas! / Speak on our behalf, well-disposed, not bearing grudge; may we be in your three-walled shelter, victorious!

147.s: saha̍sā jā̱tānpraṇu̍dā naḥ sa̱pa̱tnānpratyajā̍tānnuda jātavedaḥ adhi̍ no brūhi suma̱na̱syamā̍no va̱yam̐ syā̍ma̱ praṇu̍dā naḥ sapa̱tnān ṣoḷa̱śī stoma̱ ojo dravi̍ṇaṃ catuścatvārim̐śa stomo varco dravi̍ṇam
147.d: सह̍सा जा̱तान्प्रणु̍दा नः स̱प̱त्नान्प्रत्यजा̍तान्नुद जातवेदः अधि̍ नो ब्रूहि सुम̱न̱स्यमा̍नो व̱यम्̐ स्या̍म̱ प्रणु̍दा नः सप̱त्नान् षोऌअ̱शी स्तोम̱ ओजो द्रवि̍णं चतुश्चत्वारिम्̐श स्तोमो वर्चो द्रवि̍णम्
147.m: With might repel our born rivals; thrust away the unborn, O Jātavedas! / Speak on our behalf, being well-disposed; may we exist; repel our rivals! / The ṣoḍaśin chant is vigor and wealth; the forty-fourfold chant is luster and wealth.

147.s: agneḥ purī̍ṣama̱syapso nāma̍ tāṃ tvā viśve̍ a̱bhigṛ̍ṇantu de̱vāḥ sto̱ma̍pṛṣṭhā ghṛ̱tava̍tīha sī̍da pra̱jāva̍da̱sme dravi̍ṇāryajasva
147.d: अग्नेः पुरी̍षम̱स्यप्सो नाम̍ तां त्वा विश्वे̍ अ̱भिगृ̍णन्तु दे̱वाः स्तो̱म̍पृष्ठा घृ̱तव̍तीह सी̍द प्र̱जाव̍द̱स्मे द्रवि̍णार्यजस्व
147.m: You are the soil of Agni, apsas by name; let all the gods acclaim you! / With chants on your back, full of ghee, sit here; sacrifice for us wealth endowed with offspring!

147.s: e̱vaśchando̱ vari̍va̱śchanda̍ḥ śa̱mbhūśchanda̍ḥ pari̱bhūśchanda̍ḥ | ā̱cchacchando̱ mana̱śchando̱ vyaca̱śchanda̍ḥ
147.d: ए̱वश्छन्दो̱ वरि̍व̱श्छन्द̍ः श̱म्भूश्छन्द̍ः परि̱भूश्छन्द̍ः । आ̱च्छच्छन्दो̱ मन̱श्छन्दो̱ व्यच̱श्छन्द̍ः
147.m: Course is the metre; Wide Space is the metre; Auspicious is the metre; Encompassing is the metre. Covering is the metre; Mind is the metre; Extension is the metre.

147.s: sindhu̱śchanda̍ḥ samu̱draśchanda̍ḥ sali̱raṃ chanda̍ḥ ka̱kup chanda̍stri̱kakup chanda̍ḥ kā̱vyaṃ chando̍ aṅku̱paṃ chanda̍ḥ
147.d: सिन्धु̱श्छन्द̍ः समु̱द्रश्छन्द̍ः सलि̱रं छन्द̍ः क̱कुप् छन्द̍स्त्रि̱ककुप् छन्द̍ः का̱व्यं छन्दो̍ अङ्कु̱पं छन्द̍ः
147.m: Stream is the metre; Ocean is the metre; Flood is the metre. / Peak is the metre; Triple-Peak is the metre; Poet's Work is the metre; Curved is the metre.

147.s: a̱kṣara̍paṅkti̱śchanda̍ḥ pa̱dapa̍ṅkti̱śchando̍ vi̱ṣṭāra̍paṅkti̱śchanda̍ḥ kṣu̱robhrā̱jaśchanda̍ḥ ā̱cchacchanda̍ḥ pra̱cchacchanda̍ḥ sa̱ṃyacchando̍ vi̱yacchanda̍ḥ
147.d: अ̱क्षर̍पङ्क्ति̱श्छन्द̍ः प̱दप̍ङ्क्ति̱श्छन्दो̍ वि̱ष्टार̍पङ्क्ति̱श्छन्द̍ः क्षु̱रोभ्रा̱जश्छन्द̍ः आ̱च्छच्छन्द̍ः प्र̱च्छच्छन्द̍ः स̱ंयच्छन्दो̍ वि̱यच्छन्द̍ः
147.m: Syllable-row is the metre; Foot-row is the metre; Expanded-row is the metre; Razor-bright is the metre. / Covering is the metre; Seeking is the metre; Binding is the metre; Releasing is the metre.

147.s: bṛ̱hacchando̍ rayanta̱raṃ chando̍ ni̱kāya̱śchando̍ vi̱vadha̱śchanda̍ḥ gi̱raśchando̱ bhrāja̱śchanda̍ḥ sam̐stu̱p chando̍'nuṣṭu̱p chanda̍ḥ
147.d: बृ̱हच्छन्दो̍ रयन्त̱रं छन्दो̍ नि̱काय̱श्छन्दो̍ वि̱वध̱श्छन्द̍ः गि̱रश्छन्दो̱ भ्राज̱श्छन्द̍ः सम्̐स्तु̱प् छन्दो̍ऽनुष्टु̱प् छन्द̍ः
147.m: Bṛhat is the metre; Rathantara is the metre; Gathering is the metre; Yoke is the metre. / Song of Praise is the metre; Radiance is the metre; Saṃṣṭubh is the metre; Anuṣṭubh is the metre.

147.s: e̱vaśchando̱ vari̍va̱śchando̱ vaya̱śchando̍ vaya̱skṛcchanda̍ḥ vi̱ṣpardhā̱śchando̍ vi̱śāla̱ṃ chanda̍ścha̱diśchando̍ dūroha̱ṇaṃ chanda̍ḥ | ta̱ndraṃ chando̍ aṅkā̱ṅkaṃ chanda̍ḥ
147.d: ए̱वश्छन्दो̱ वरि̍व̱श्छन्दो̱ वय̱श्छन्दो̍ वय̱स्कृच्छन्द̍ः वि̱ष्पर्धा̱श्छन्दो̍ वि̱शाल̱ं छन्द̍श्छ̱दिश्छन्दो̍ दूरोह̱णं छन्द̍ः । त̱न्द्रं छन्दो̍ अङ्का̱ङ्कं छन्द̍ः
147.m: Course is the metre; Wide Space is the metre; Vital Vigour is the metre; Maker of Vital Vigour is the metre. / Rivalry is the metre; Spacious is the metre; Covering is the metre; Difficult of Ascent is the metre. Weariness is the metre; Crooked-curved is the metre.

148.s: (1)8 ra̱śminā̍ sa̱tyāya̍ sa̱tyaṃ ji̍nva̱ preti̍nā dha̱rmeṇā̱ dharma̍ṃ jinva anvi̍tyā di̱vā diva̍ṃ jinva sa̱ndhinā̱ntari̍kṣeṇā̱ntari̍kṣaṃ jinva
148.d: (1)8 र̱श्मिना̍ स̱त्याय̍ स̱त्यं जि̍न्व̱ प्रेति̍ना ध̱र्मेणा̱ धर्म̍ं जिन्व अन्वि̍त्या दि̱वा दिव̍ं जिन्व स̱न्धिना̱न्तरि̍क्षेणा̱न्तरि̍क्षं जिन्व
148.m: With the ray enliven truth for truth; with the setting forth, through order, enliven order. / With the following, through heaven, enliven heaven; with the joint, through mid-air, enliven mid-air.

148.s: pra̱tidhi̍nā pṛthi̱vyā pṛ̍thi̱vīṃ ji̍nva vi̱ṣṭambhe̍na̱ vṛṣṭyā vṛṣṭi̍ṃ jinva pra̱vayāhnāha̍rjinvānu̱yā rātryā rātrī̍ṃ jinva
148.d: प्र̱तिधि̍ना पृथि̱व्या पृ̍थि̱वीं जि̍न्व वि̱ष्टम्भे̍न̱ वृष्ट्या वृष्टि̍ं जिन्व प्र̱वयाह्नाह̍र्जिन्वानु̱या रात्र्या रात्री̍ं जिन्व
148.m: With the cross-beam, through earth, enliven earth; with the support, through rain, enliven rain. / With the forth-going, through day, enliven day; with the following, through night, enliven night.

148.s: u̱śijā̱ vasu̍bhyo̱ vasū̍ñjinva pra̱ketenā̍di̱tyebhya̍ ādi̱tyāñji̍nva tantū̍nā rā̱yaspoṣe̍ṇa rā̱yaspoṣa̍ṃ jinva sam̐sa̱rpeṇa̍ śru̱tāya̍ śru̱taṃ ji̍nva
148.d: उ̱शिजा̱ वसु̍भ्यो̱ वसू̍ञ्जिन्व प्र̱केतेना̍दि̱त्येभ्य̍ आदि̱त्याञ्जि̍न्व तन्तू̍ना रा̱यस्पोषे̍ण रा̱यस्पोष̍ं जिन्व सम्̐स̱र्पेण̍ श्रु̱ताय̍ श्रु̱तं जि̍न्व
148.m: With the willing one, enliven the Vasus for the Vasus; with the beacon, enliven the Ādityas for the Ādityas. / With the thread, through increase of wealth, enliven increase of wealth; with the creeping, for tradition, enliven tradition.

148.s: aiḷenauṣa̍dhībhi̱roṣa̍dhīrjinvotta̱mena̍ ta̱nūbhi̍sta̱nūrji̍nva vayo̱dhasādhī̍te̱nādhī̍taṃ jinvābhi̱jitā̱ teja̍sā̱ tejo̍ jinva
148.d: ऐऌएनौष̍धीभि̱रोष̍धीर्जिन्वोत्त̱मेन̍ त̱नूभि̍स्त̱नूर्जि̍न्व वयो̱धसाधी̍ते̱नाधी̍तं जिन्वाभि̱जिता̱ तेज̍सा̱ तेजो̍ जिन्व
148.m: With the offspring of Ilā, through plants, enliven plants; with the supreme one, through bodies, enliven bodies. / With the maker of vital vigour, through what is studied, enliven what is studied; with the victorious, through fiery brilliance, enliven fiery brilliance.

148.s: pra̱tipa̍dasi prati̱pade̍ tvā'nu̱pada̍syanu̱pade̍ tvā | sa̱mpada̍si sa̱mpade̍ tvā tejo̍'si̱ teja̍se tvā
148.d: प्र̱तिप̍दसि प्रति̱पदे̍ त्वाऽनु̱पद̍स्यनु̱पदे̍ त्वा । स̱म्पद̍सि स̱म्पदे̍ त्वा तेजो̍ऽसि̱ तेज̍से त्वा
148.m: You are the introduction; for the introduction [I take] you. You are the subsequent verse; for the subsequent verse [I take] you. / You are the accomplishment; for the accomplishment [I take] you. You are fiery brilliance; for fiery brilliance [I take] you.

148.s: tri̱vṛda̍si tri̱vṛte̍ tvā pra̱vṛda̍si pra̱vṛte̍ tvā | vi̱vṛda̍si vi̱vṛte̍ tvā sa̱vṛda̍si sa̱vṛte̍ tvā
148.d: त्रि̱वृद̍सि त्रि̱वृते̍ त्वा प्र̱वृद̍सि प्र̱वृते̍ त्वा । वि̱वृद̍सि वि̱वृते̍ त्वा स̱वृद̍सि स̱वृते̍ त्वा
148.m: You are threefold; for the threefold [I take] you. You are the unfolding; for the unfolding [I take] you. / You are the unfolding apart; for the unfolding apart [I take] you. You are the rolling together; for the rolling together [I take] you.

148.s:
ā̱kra̱mo̍'syākra̱māya̍ tvā saṅkra̱mo̍'si saṅkra̱māya̍ tvā utkra̱mo̍'syutkra̱māya̍ tvotkrā̍nti̱rasyutkrā̍ntyai tvā adhi̍patino̱rjeja̍ṃ jinva̱ veṣa̍śrīḥ kṣa̱trāya̍ kṣa̱traṃ ji̍nva
(2)
148.d:
आ̱क्र̱मो̍ऽस्याक्र̱माय̍ त्वा सङ्क्र̱मो̍ऽसि सङ्क्र̱माय̍ त्वा उत्क्र̱मो̍ऽस्युत्क्र̱माय̍ त्वोत्क्रा̍न्ति̱रस्युत्क्रा̍न्त्यै त्वा अधि̍पतिनो̱र्जेज̍ं जिन्व̱ वेष̍श्रीः क्ष̱त्राय̍ क्ष̱त्रं जि̍न्व
(2)
148.m: You are the onward step; for the onward step [I take] you. You are the transition; for the transition [I take] you. / You are the upward step; for the upward step [I take] you. You are the ascension; for the ascension [I take] you. / As overlord, enliven food with food; having the glory of beauty, enliven princely power for princely power.

149.s: rājñya̍si̱ prācī̱ digdasa̍vaste de̱vā adhi̍patayaḥ | a̱gnirhetīnā̍ṃ pratidha̱rtā
149.d: राज्ञ्य̍सि̱ प्राची̱ दिग्दस̍वस्ते दे̱वा अधि̍पतयः । अ̱ग्निर्हेतीना̍ं प्रतिध̱र्ता
149.m: You are the queen, the eastern direction; the Vasus are your divine overlords; Agni is the repeller of missiles.

149.s: tri̱vṛt tvā̱ stoma̍: pṛthi̱vyām̐ śra̍ya̱tvājya̍mu̱kthamavya̍thāyai stabhnātu rathanta̱ram̐ sāma̱ prati̍ṣṭhityā a̱ntari̍kṣe
149.d: त्रि̱वृत् त्वा̱ स्तोम̍: पृथि̱व्याम्̐ श्र̍य̱त्वाज्य̍मु̱क्थमव्य̍थायै स्तभ्नातु रथन्त̱रम्̐ साम̱ प्रति̍ष्ठित्या अ̱न्तरि̍क्षे
149.m: May the threefold chant support you on earth; may the ājya recitation sustain [you] against shaking; / the Rathantara sāman for standing firm in mid-air.

149.s: ṛṣa̍yastvā prathama̱jā de̱veṣu̍ di̱vo mā̱trayā̍ vari̱mṇā pra̍thantu vi̱dha̱rtā cā̱yamadhi̍patiśca te tvā̱ sarve̍ saṃvidā̱nā nāka̍sya pṛ̱ṣṭhe sva̱rge lo̱ke yaja̍mānaṃ ca sādayantu
149.d: ऋष̍यस्त्वा प्रथम̱जा दे̱वेषु̍ दि̱वो मा̱त्रया̍ वरि̱म्णा प्र̍थन्तु वि̱ध̱र्ता चा̱यमधि̍पतिश्च ते त्वा̱ सर्वे̍ संविदा̱ना नाक̍स्य पृ̱ष्ठे स्व̱र्गे लो̱के यज̍मानं च सादयन्तु
149.m: May the first-born seers among the gods extend you with the measure and breadth of heaven. / And may this supporter and overlord, all being of one accord, seat you and the sacrificer on the back of the firmament, in the heavenly world.

149.s: vi̱rāḍa̍si̱ dakṣi̍ṇā di̱grudrāste̍ de̱vā adhi̍patayaḥ | indro̍ hetīnā̍ṃ pratidha̱rtā
149.d: वि̱राड̍सि̱ दक्षि̍णा दि̱ग्रुद्रास्ते̍ दे̱वा अधि̍पतयः । इन्द्रो̍ हेतीना̍ं प्रतिध̱र्ता
149.m: You are the sovereign, the southern direction; the Rudras are your divine overlords; Indra is the repeller of missiles.

149.s: pañca̍daśastvā̱ stoma̍: pṛthi̱vyām̐ śra̍yatu pra u̍gamu̱kthamavya̍thāyai stabhnātu bṛ̱hatsāma̱ prati̍ṣṭhityā a̱ntari̍kṣe
149.d: पञ्च̍दशस्त्वा̱ स्तोम̍: पृथि̱व्याम्̐ श्र̍यतु प्र उ̍गमु̱क्थमव्य̍थायै स्तभ्नातु बृ̱हत्साम̱ प्रति̍ष्ठित्या अ̱न्तरि̍क्षे
149.m: May the fifteenfold chant support you on earth; may the praüga recitation sustain [you] against shaking; / the Bṛhat sāman for standing firm in mid-air.

149.s: ṛṣa̍yastvā prathama̱jā de̱veṣu̍ di̱vo mā̱trayā̍ vari̱mṇā pra̍thantu vi̱dha̱rtā cā̱yamadhi̍patiśca te tvā̱ sarve̍ saṃvidā̱nā nāka̍sya pṛ̱ṣṭhe sva̱rge lo̱ke yaja̍mānaṃ ca sādayantu
149.d: ऋष̍यस्त्वा प्रथम̱जा दे̱वेषु̍ दि̱वो मा̱त्रया̍ वरि̱म्णा प्र̍थन्तु वि̱ध̱र्ता चा̱यमधि̍पतिश्च ते त्वा̱ सर्वे̍ संविदा̱ना नाक̍स्य पृ̱ष्ठे स्व̱र्गे लो̱के यज̍मानं च सादयन्तु
149.m:
May the first-born seers among the gods extend you with the measure and breadth of heaven.
And may this upholder and the overlord, all being in agreement, settle you and the sacrificer on the back of the firmament in the world of heaven.

149.s: sa̱mrāḍa̍si pra̱tīcī̱ digā̍di̱tyāste̍ de̱vā adhi̍patayaḥ | varu̍ṇo hetīnā̍ṃ pratidha̱rtā
149.d: स̱म्राड̍सि प्र̱तीची̱ दिगा̍दि̱त्यास्ते̍ दे̱वा अधि̍पतयः । वरु̍णो हेतीना̍ं प्रतिध̱र्ता
149.m: You are sovereign, the western quarter; the Ādityas, the gods, are your overlords; Varuṇa is the warder off of missiles.

149.s: sa̱pta̱da̱śastvā̱ stoma̍: pṛthi̱vyām̐ śra̍yatu marutva̱tīya̍mu̱kthamavya̍thāyai stabhnātu vai̱rū̱pam̐ sāma̱ prati̍ṣṭhityā a̱ntari̍kṣe
149.d: स̱प्त̱द̱शस्त्वा̱ स्तोम̍: पृथि̱व्याम्̐ श्र̍यतु मरुत्व̱तीय̍मु̱क्थमव्य̍थायै स्तभ्नातु वै̱रू̱पम्̐ साम̱ प्रति̍ष्ठित्या अ̱न्तरि̍क्षे
149.m:
May the seventeen-fold stoma support you on earth; may the Marutvatīya uktha uphold [you] for unswerving firmness;
[may] the Vairūpa sāman for stability in the mid-air.

149.s: ṛṣa̍yastvā prathama̱jā de̱veṣu̍ di̱vo mā̱trayā̍ vari̱mṇā pra̍thantu vi̱dha̱rtā cā̱yamadhi̍patiśca te tvā̱ sarve̍ saṃvidā̱nā nāka̍sya pṛ̱ṣṭhe sva̱rge lo̱ke yaja̍mānaṃ ca sādayantu
149.d: ऋष̍यस्त्वा प्रथम̱जा दे̱वेषु̍ दि̱वो मा̱त्रया̍ वरि̱म्णा प्र̍थन्तु वि̱ध̱र्ता चा̱यमधि̍पतिश्च ते त्वा̱ सर्वे̍ संविदा̱ना नाक̍स्य पृ̱ष्ठे स्व̱र्गे लो̱के यज̍मानं च सादयन्तु
149.m:
May the first-born seers among the gods extend you with the measure and breadth of heaven.
And may this upholder and the overlord, all being in agreement, settle you and the sacrificer on the back of the firmament in the world of heaven.

149.s: sva̱rāḍa̱syudī̍cī̱ diṅ ma̱ruta̍ste de̱vā adhi̍patayaḥ | somo̍ hetīnā̍ṃ pratidha̱rtā
149.d: स्व̱राड̱स्युदी̍ची̱ दिङ् म̱रुत̍स्ते दे̱वा अधि̍पतयः । सोमो̍ हेतीना̍ं प्रतिध̱र्ता
149.m: You are self-ruling, the northern quarter; the Maruts, the gods, are your overlords; Soma is the warder off of missiles.

149.s: e̱ka̱vim̐śastvā̱ stoma̍: pṛthi̱vyām̐ śra̍yatu niṣkaiva̱lyamu̱kthamavya̍thāyai stabhnātu vai̱rā̱jam̐ sāma̱ prati̍ṣṭhityā a̱ntari̍kṣe
149.d: ए̱क̱विम्̐शस्त्वा̱ स्तोम̍: पृथि̱व्याम्̐ श्र̍यतु निष्कैव̱ल्यमु̱क्थमव्य̍थायै स्तभ्नातु वै̱रा̱जम्̐ साम̱ प्रति̍ष्ठित्या अ̱न्तरि̍क्षे
149.m:
May the twenty-one-fold stoma support you on earth; may the Niṣkevalya uktha uphold [you] for unswerving firmness;
[may] the Vairāja sāman for stability in the mid-air.

149.s: ṛṣa̍yastvā prathama̱jā de̱veṣu̍ di̱vo mā̱trayā̍ vari̱mṇā pra̍thantu vi̱dha̱rtā cā̱yamadhi̍patiśca te tvā̱ sarve̍ saṃvidā̱nā nāka̍sya pṛ̱ṣṭhe sva̱rge lo̱ke yaja̍mānaṃ ca sādayantu
149.d: ऋष̍यस्त्वा प्रथम̱जा दे̱वेषु̍ दि̱वो मा̱त्रया̍ वरि̱म्णा प्र̍थन्तु वि̱ध̱र्ता चा̱यमधि̍पतिश्च ते त्वा̱ सर्वे̍ संविदा̱ना नाक̍स्य पृ̱ष्ठे स्व̱र्गे लो̱के यज̍मानं च सादयन्तु
149.m:
May the first-born seers among the gods extend you with the measure and breadth of heaven.
And may this upholder and the overlord, all being in agreement, settle you and the sacrificer on the back of the firmament in the world of heaven.

149.s: adhi̍patnyasi bṛha̱tī digviśve̍ te de̱vā adhi̍patayaḥ | bṛha̱spati̍rhetīnā̍ṃ pratidha̱rtā
149.d: अधि̍पत्न्यसि बृह̱ती दिग्विश्वे̍ ते दे̱वा अधि̍पतयः । बृह̱स्पति̍र्हेतीना̍ं प्रतिध̱र्ता
149.m: You are paramount, the lofty quarter; the All-Gods, the gods, are your overlords; Bṛhaspati is the warder off of missiles.

149.s: triṇavatrayastrim̐śau tvā stomau pṛthivyām̐ śrayatāṃ vaiśvadevāgnimārute ukthe avyathāyai stabhnītām śākvararaivate sāmanī pratiṣṭhityai antarikṣe
149.d: त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिम्̐शौ त्वा स्तोमौ पृथिव्याम्̐ श्रयतां वैश्वदेवाग्निमारुते उक्थे अव्यथायै स्तभ्नीताम् शाक्वररैवते सामनी प्रतिष्ठित्यै अन्तरिक्षे
149.m:
May the twenty-seven-fold and thirty-three-fold stomas support you on earth; may the Vaiśvadeva and Āgnimāruta ukthas uphold [you] for unswerving firmness;
[may] the Śākvara and Raivata sāmans for stability in the mid-air.

149.s: ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
149.d: ऋषयस्त्वा प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथन्तु विधर्ता चायमधिपतिश्च ते त्वा सर्वे संविदाना नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानं च सादयन्तु
149.m:
May the first-born seers among the gods extend you with the measure and breadth of heaven.
And may this upholder and the overlord, all being in agreement, settle you and the sacrificer on the back of the firmament in the world of heaven.

150.s: (3) ayaṃ puro harikeśaḥ sūryaraśmistasya rathagṛtsaśca rathaujāśca senānīgrāmaṇyau puñjikasthalā ca kratusthalā cāpsarasau daṅkṣṇavaḥ paśavo hetiḥ pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ prahetiḥ
150.d: (3) अयं पुरो हरिकेशः सूर्यरश्मिस्तस्य रथगृत्सश्च रथौजाश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ पुञ्जिकस्थला च क्रतुस्थला चाप्सरसौ दङ्क्ष्णवः पशवो हेतिः पौरुषेयो वधः प्रहेतिः
150.m:
This one to the east is the golden-haired, sun-beamed [one]; his commander and village-chief are Rathagṛtsa and Rathaujā;
Puñjikasthalā and Kratusthalā are the Apsarases; biting animals are his missile, slaughter of men his launched weapon.

150.s: tebhyo namo astu te no mṛḷayantu te no'vantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
150.d: तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नो मृऌअयन्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः
150.m:
Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they help us!
Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place within their jaws.

150.s: ayaṃ dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya rathasvanaśca rathecitraśca senānīgrāmaṇyau menakā ca sahajanyā cāpsarasau yātudhānā hetī rakṣām̐si prahetiḥ
150.d: अयं दक्षिणा विश्वकर्मा तस्य रथस्वनश्च रथेचित्रश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ मेनका च सहजन्या चाप्सरसौ यातुधाना हेती रक्षाम्̐सि प्रहेतिः
150.m:
This one to the south is all-working; his commander and village-chief are Rathasvana and Rathecitra;
Menakā and Sahajanyā are the Apsarases; sorcerers are his missile, rakṣases his launched weapon.

150.s: tebhyo namo astu te no mṛḷayantu te no'vantu | te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
150.d: तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नो मृऌअयन्तु ते नोऽवन्तु । ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः
150.m: Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they help us! Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place within their jaws.

150.s: ayaṃ paścādviśvavyacāstasya rathaprotaścāsamarathaśca senānīgrāmaṇyau pramlocantī cānumlocantī cāpsarasau vyāghrā hetiḥ sarpāḥ prahetiḥ
150.d: अयं पश्चाद्विश्वव्यचास्तस्य रथप्रोतश्चासमरथश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ प्रम्लोचन्ती चानुम्लोचन्ती चाप्सरसौ व्याघ्रा हेतिः सर्पाः प्रहेतिः
150.m:
This one to the west is all-encompassing; his commander and village-chief are Rathaprota and Asamaratha;
Pramlocantī and Anumlocantī are the Apsarases; tigers are his missile, serpents his launched weapon.

150.s: tebhyo namo astu te no mṛḷayantu te no'vantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
150.d: तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नो मृऌअयन्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः
150.m:
Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they help us!
Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place within their jaws.

150.s: ayamuttarātsaṃyadvasustasya tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca senānīgrāmaṇyau viśvācī ca ghṛtācī cāpsarasā āpo hetirvātaḥ prahetiḥ
150.d: अयमुत्तरात्संयद्वसुस्तस्य तार्क्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ विश्वाची च घृताची चाप्सरसा आपो हेतिर्वातः प्रहेतिः
150.m:
This one to the north is accumulating wealth; his commander and village-chief are Tārkṣya and Ariṣṭanemi;
Viśvācī and Ghṛtācī are the Apsarases; the waters are his missile, the wind his launched weapon.

150.s: tebhyo namo astu te no mṛḷayantu te no'vantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
150.d: तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नो मृऌअयन्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः
150.m:
Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they help us!
Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place within their jaws.

150.s: ayamuparyarvāgvasustasya senajicca suṣeṇaśca senānīgrāmaṇyau urvaśī ca pūrvacittiścāpsarasā avasphūrjanhetirvidyutprahetiḥ
150.d: अयमुपर्यर्वाग्वसुस्तस्य सेनजिच्च सुषेणश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ उर्वशी च पूर्वचित्तिश्चाप्सरसा अवस्फूर्जन्हेतिर्विद्युत्प्रहेतिः
150.m:
This one above is focused on wealth; his commander and village-chief are Senajit and Suṣeṇa;
Urvaśī and Pūrvacitti are the Apsarases; thunder is his missile, lightning his launched weapon.

150.s: tebhyo namo astu te no mṛḷayatu te no'vantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
150.d: तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नो मृऌअयतु ते नोऽवन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः
150.m:
Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they help us!
Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place within their jaws.

151.s: (4) agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apām̐ retām̐si jinvati
151.d: (4) अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपाम्̐ रेताम्̐सि जिन्वति
151.m:
Agni is the head of heaven, the peak, the lord of this earth;
he quickens the seeds of the waters.

151.s: ayamagniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinaspatiḥ | mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām
151.d: अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः । मूर्धा कवी रयीणाम्
151.m:
This Agni is the lord of thousandfold, of hundredfold vital vigor,
the head, the poet of riches.

151.s: tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ
151.d: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत । मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः
151.m:
From the blue lotus flower Atharvan churned you forth, O Agni,
from the head of the whole world, the sacrificer.

151.s: bhuvo̍ ya̱jñasya̱ raja̍saśca ne̱tā yatrā̍ ni̱yudbhi̱ḥ saca̍se śi̱vābhi̍: di̱vi mū̱rdhāna̍ṃ dadhiṣe sva̱rṣā ji̱hvāma̍gne cakṛṣe havya̱vāha̍m
151.d: भुवो̍ य̱ज्ञस्य̱ रज̍सश्च ने̱ता यत्रा̍ नि̱युद्भि̱ः सच̍से शि̱वाभि̍: दि̱वि मू̱र्धान̍ं दधिषे स्व̱र्षा जि̱ह्वाम̍ग्ने चकृषे हव्य̱वाह̍म्
151.m:
You have become the guide of the sacrifice and of the realm, wherever you attend with your propitious teams of mares;
in heaven you have set your head, winning heaven; O Agni, you have made your tongue the bearer of oblations.

151.s: abo̍dhya̱gniḥ sa̱midhā̱ janā̍nā̱ṃ prati̍ dhe̱numi̍vāya̱tīmu̱ṣāsa̍m ya̱hvā i̍va̱ pra va̱yāmu̱jjihā̍nā̱ḥ pra bhā̱nava̍: sisrate̱ nāka̱maccha̍
151.d: अबो̍ध्य̱ग्निः स̱मिधा̱ जना̍ना̱ं प्रति̍ धे̱नुमि̍वाय̱तीमु̱षास̍म् य̱ह्वा इ̍व̱ प्र व̱यामु̱ज्जिहा̍ना̱ः प्र भा̱नव̍: सिस्रते̱ नाक̱मच्छ̍
151.m:
Agni has awakened through the fuel of men, turning toward the coming Dawn like a cow;
like the youngest [birds] rising up to the branch, his beams surge forward toward the firmament.

151.s: avo̍cāma ka̱vaye̱ medhyā̍ya̱ vaco̍ va̱ndāru̍ vṛṣa̱bhāya̱ vṛṣṇe̍ gavi̍ṣṭhiro̱ nama̍sā̱ stoma̍ma̱gnau di̱vī̍va ru̱kmamu̍ru̱vyañca̍maśret
151.d: अवो̍चाम क̱वये̱ मेध्या̍य̱ वचो̍ व̱न्दारु̍ वृष̱भाय̱ वृष्णे̍ गवि̍ष्ठिरो̱ नम̍सा̱ स्तोम̍म̱ग्नौ दि̱वी̍व रु̱क्ममु̍रु̱व्यञ्च̍मश्रेत्
151.m:
We have spoken praising speech to the poet, the sacrificial, the bull, the manly [Agni];
with homage Gaviṣṭhira has set up his praise in Agni, as a wide-spreading golden plaque in heaven.

151.s: a̱yami̱ha pra̍tha̱mo dhā̍yi dhā̱tṛbhi̱rhotā̱ yaji̍ṣṭho adhva̱reṣvīḍya̍: ya̱mapna̍vāno̱ bhṛga̍vo viruru̱curvane̍ṣu ci̱traṃ vi̱bhva̍ṃ vi̱śevi̍śe
151.d: अ̱यमि̱ह प्र̍थ̱मो धा̍यि धा̱तृभि̱र्होता̱ यजि̍ष्ठो अध्व̱रेष्वीड्य̍: य̱मप्न̍वानो̱ भृग̍वो विरुरु̱चुर्वने̍षु चि̱त्रं वि̱भ्व̍ं वि̱शेवि̍शे
151.m:
This one was established here first by the creators as Hotṛ, most worthy of sacrifice, to be praised in rituals,
whom Apnavāna and the Bhṛgus brought forth to shine, wondrous in the woods, far-reaching for every clan.

151.s: jana̍sya go̱pā a̍janiṣṭa̱ jāgṛ̍vi̱ragni̍ḥ su̱dakṣa̍: suvi̱tāya̱ navya̍se ghṛ̱tapra̍tīko bṛha̱tā di̍vi̱spṛśā̍ dyu̱madvi bhā̍ti bhara̱tebhya̱ḥ śuci̍:
151.d: जन̍स्य गो̱पा अ̍जनिष्ट̱ जागृ̍वि̱रग्नि̍ः सु̱दक्ष̍: सुवि̱ताय̱ नव्य̍से घृ̱तप्र̍तीको बृह̱ता दि̍वि̱स्पृशा̍ द्यु̱मद्वि भा̍ति भर̱तेभ्य̱ः शुचि̍:
151.m:
The wakeful protector of the people has been born, Agni of good insight, for new well-being;
with face of ghee, bright, touching heaven with his greatness, he shines resplendent for the Bharatas.

151.s: tvāma̍gne̱ aṅgi̍raso̱ guhā̍ hi̱tamanva̍vindañchiśriyā̱ṇaṃ vane̍vane sa jā̍yase ma̱thyamā̍na̱ḥ saho̍ ma̱hattvāmā̍hu̱ḥ saha̍saspu̱trama̍ṅgiraḥ
151.d: त्वाम̍ग्ने̱ अङ्गि̍रसो̱ गुहा̍ हि̱तमन्व̍विन्दञ्छिश्रिया̱णं वने̍वने स जा̍यसे म̱थ्यमा̍न̱ः सहो̍ म̱हत्त्वामा̍हु̱ः सह̍सस्पु̱त्रम̍ङ्गिरः
151.m:
You, O Agni, hidden in the secret place, the Aṅgirases found taking refuge in wood after wood;
as you are churned, you are born as great strength; you they call the son of strength, O Aṅgiras!

151.s: sakhā̍ya̱ḥ saṃ va̍: sa̱myañca̱miṣa̱m̐ stoma̍ṃ cā̱gnaye̍ | varṣi̍ṣṭhāya kṣitī̱nāmūrjo naptre̱ saha̍svate
151.d: सखा̍य̱ः सं व̍: स̱म्यञ्च̱मिष̱म्̐ स्तोम̍ं चा̱ग्नये̍ । वर्षि̍ष्ठाय क्षिती̱नामूर्जो नप्त्रे̱ सह̍स्वते
151.m:
Comrades, offer your united food and praise to Agni,
to the highest of the settlements, the son of strength, the mighty one!

151.s: sam̐ sa̱midyu̍vase vṛṣa̱nnagne̱ viśvā̍nya̱rya ā | i̱ḷaspa̱de sami̍dhyase̱ sa no̱ vasū̱nyābha̍ra
151.d: सम्̐ स̱मिद्यु̍वसे वृष̱न्नग्ने̱ विश्वा̍न्य̱र्य आ । इ̱ऌअस्प̱दे समि̍ध्यसे̱ स नो̱ वसू̱न्याभ̍र
151.m:
With the kindling you unite, O bull, O Agni, all the wealth of the noble one;
you are kindled in the place of nourishment: so bring us treasures!

151.s: tvāma̍gne havi̱ṣma̍nto de̱vaṃ martā̍sa īḷate | manye̍ tvā jā̱tave̍dasa̱m̐ sa ha̱vyā va̍kṣyā̱nuṣak
151.d: त्वाम̍ग्ने हवि̱ष्म̍न्तो दे̱वं मर्ता̍स ईऌअते । मन्ये̍ त्वा जा̱तवे̍दस̱म्̐ स ह̱व्या व̍क्ष्या̱नुषक्
151.m:
Mortals with oblation praise you, the god, O Agni;
I consider you as Jātavedas, so convey the oblations in uninterrupted succession!

151.s: tvāṃ ci̍traśravastama̱ hava̍nte vi̱kṣu ja̱ntava̍: | śo̱ciṣke̍śaṃ purupri̱yāgne̍ ha̱vyāya̱ voḷha̍ve
151.d: त्वां चि̍त्रश्रवस्तम̱ हव̍न्ते वि̱क्षु ज̱न्तव̍: । शो̱चिष्के̍शं पुरुप्रि̱याग्ने̍ ह̱व्याय̱ वोऌह̍वे
151.m:
You of most wondrous fame the creatures call upon among the clans,
you with flame-hair, beloved of many, O Agni, to bear the oblation.

151.s: e̱nā vo̍ a̱gniṃ nama̍so̱rjo napā̍ta̱māhu̍ve | pri̱yaṃ ceti̍ṣṭhamara̱tim̐ sva̍dhva̱raṃ viśva̍sya dū̱tama̱mṛta̍m
151.d: ए̱ना वो̍ अ̱ग्निं नम̍सो̱र्जो नपा̍त̱माहु̍वे । प्रि̱यं चेति̍ष्ठमर̱तिम्̐ स्व̍ध्व̱रं विश्व̍स्य दू̱तम̱मृत̍म्
151.m:
Thus with homage I invoke your Agni, the son of strength,
the dear, most attentive messenger, good at sacrifice, the immortal envoy of all.

The immortal messenger of all, the immortal messenger of all; / he yokes the two ruddy ones that nourish all, as he runs forth, well-offered.

151.s: viśva̍sya dū̱tama̱mṛta̍ṃ vi̱śvasya dū̱tama̱mṛta̍m | sa yo̍jate aru̱ṣā vi̱śvabho̍jasā̱ sa du̍drava̱tsvāhu̍taḥ
151.d: विश्व̍स्य दू̱तम̱मृत̍ं वि̱श्वस्य दू̱तम̱मृत̍म् । स यो̍जते अरु̱षा वि̱श्वभो̍जसा̱ स दु̍द्रव̱त्स्वाहु̍तः
151.m: As he runs forth, well-offered, as he runs forth, well-offered; / well-attended with sacred formulation is the sacrifice, well-performed, of goods, a divine gift for the people.

151.s: sa du̍drava̱t svāhu̍ta̱ḥ sa du̍drava̱t svāhu̍taḥ | su̱brahmā̍ ya̱jñaḥ su̱śamī̱ vasū̍nāṃ de̱vam̐ rādho̱ janā̍nām
151.d: स दु̍द्रव̱त् स्वाहु̍त̱ः स दु̍द्रव̱त् स्वाहु̍तः । सु̱ब्रह्मा̍ य̱ज्ञः सु̱शमी̱ वसू̍नां दे̱वम्̐ राधो̱ जना̍नाम्

151.s: agne̱ vāja̍sya̱ goma̍ta̱ īśā̍naḥ sahaso yaho | a̱sme dhe̍hi jātavedo̱ mahi̱ śrava̍:
151.d: अग्ने̱ वाज̍स्य̱ गोम̍त̱ ईशा̍नः सहसो यहो । अ̱स्मे धे̍हि जातवेदो̱ महि̱ श्रव̍:
151.m: O Agni, ruler of vital vigor rich in cattle, child of strength, / place in us, O Jātavedas, great renown.

151.s: sa ī̍dhāno vasu̍ṣkṛ̱vira̱gnirīḷenyo̍ gi̱rā | re̱vada̱smabhya̍ṃ purvaṇīka dīdihi
151.d: स ई̍धानो वसु̍ष्कृ̱विर̱ग्निरीऌएन्यो̍ गि̱रा । रे̱वद̱स्मभ्य̍ं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि
151.m: Kindled, Agni the sage, rich in goods, is to be praised with song; / shine richly for us, O many-faced one.

151.s: kṣa̱po rā̍jannu̱ta tmanā̍gne̱ vasto̍ru̱toṣasa̍: | sa ti̍gmajambha ra̱kṣaso̍ daha̱ prati̍
151.d: क्ष̱पो रा̍जन्नु̱त त्मना̍ग्ने̱ वस्तो̍रु̱तोषस̍: । स ति̍ग्मजम्भ र̱क्षसो̍ दह̱ प्रति̍
151.m: Ruling through the nights and by thyself, O Agni, by day and at dawns, / sharp-toothed, burn back the demons.

151.s: bha̱dro no̍ a̱gnirāhu̍to bha̱drā rā̱tiḥ su̍bha̱ga bha̱dro a̍dhva̱raḥ | bha̱drā u̱ta praśa̍stayaḥ
151.d: भ̱द्रो नो̍ अ̱ग्निराहु̍तो भ̱द्रा रा̱तिः सु̍भ̱ग भ̱द्रो अ̍ध्व̱रः । भ̱द्रा उ̱त प्रश̍स्तयः
151.m:
Auspicious for us two is Agni when offered, auspicious the gift, O fortunate one, auspicious the sacrifice; / and auspicious are the praises.

And auspicious are the praises; make your mind auspicious in the slaying of Vṛtra, / wherewith you may prevail in battles.

151.s: bha̱drā u̱ta praśa̍stayo bha̱draṃ mana̍: kṛṇuṣva vṛtra̱tūrye̍ | yenā̍ sa̱matsu̍ sā̱saha̍:
151.d: भ̱द्रा उ̱त प्रश̍स्तयो भ̱द्रं मन̍: कृणुष्व वृत्र̱तूर्ये̍ । येना̍ स̱मत्सु̍ सा̱सह̍:
151.m: Wherewith you may prevail in battles; unbend the firm [bows] of those who boast abundantly; / may we win through your assistances.

151.s: yenā̍ sa̱matsu̍ sā̱saho'va̍ sthi̱rā ta̍nuhi̱ bhūri̱ śardha̍tām | vane̍māṃ te a̱bhiṣṭi̍bhiḥ
151.d: येना̍ स̱मत्सु̍ सा̱सहोऽव̍ स्थि̱रा त̍नुहि̱ भूरि̱ शर्ध̍ताम् । वने̍मां ते अ̱भिष्टि̍भिः

151.s: a̱gniṃ taṃ ma̍nye̱ yo vasu̱rasta̱ṃ yaṃ yanti̍ dhe̱nava̍: asta̱marva̍nta ā̱śavo'sta̱ṃ nityā̍so vā̱jina̱ iṣa̍m̐ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ābha̍ra
151.d: अ̱ग्निं तं म̍न्ये̱ यो वसु̱रस्त̱ं यं यन्ति̍ धे̱नव̍: अस्त̱मर्व̍न्त आ̱शवोऽस्त̱ं नित्या̍सो वा̱जिन̱ इष̍म्̐ स्तो̱तृभ्य̱ आभ̍र
151.m: I think of that Agni who is good, to whom as home the milk-cows go, / to whom as home the swift steeds, to whom as home their own racers go; bring refreshment to the praisers.

151.s: so a̱gniryo vasu̍rgu̱ṇe saṃ yamāya̱nti̍ dhe̱nava̍ḥ samarva̍nto raghudruva̍ḥ sam̐ su̍jā̱tāsa̍ḥ sū̱raya̱ iṣa̱m̐ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ābha̍ra
151.d: सो अ̱ग्निर्यो वसु̍र्गु̱णे सं यमाय̱न्ति̍ धे̱नव̍ः समर्व̍न्तो रघुद्रुव̍ः सम्̐ सु̍जा̱तास̍ः सू̱रय̱ इष̱म्̐ स्तो̱तृभ्य̱ आभ̍र
151.m: That Agni who is good is praised, together to whom the milk-cows come, / together the swift-running steeds, together the well-born patrons; bring refreshment to the praisers.

151.s: u̱bhe su̍ścandra sa̱rpiṣo̱ darvī̍ śrīṇīṣa ā̱sani̍ u̱to na̱ utpū̍pūryā u̱ktheṣu̍ śavasaspata̱ iṣa̱m̐ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ābha̍ra
151.d: उ̱भे सु̍श्चन्द्र स̱र्पिषो̱ दर्वी̍ श्रीणीष आ̱सनि̍ उ̱तो न̱ उत्पू̍पूर्या उ̱क्थेषु̍ शवसस्पत̱ इष̱म्̐ स्तो̱तृभ्य̱ आभ̍र
151.m: Both ladles, O brightly shining one, you mix with melted butter in your mouth; / and fill us fully in our chants, O lord of might; bring refreshment to the praisers.

151.s: agne̱ tama̱dyāśva̍ṃ na sto̱maiḥ kratu̍ṃ na bha̱dram̐ hṛ̍di̱spṛśa̍m | ṛ̱dhyāmā̍ ta̱ oha̍aiḥ
151.d: अग्ने̱ तम̱द्याश्व̍ं न स्तो̱मैः क्रतु̍ं न भ̱द्रम्̐ हृ̍दि̱स्पृश̍म् । ऋ̱ध्यामा̍ त̱ ओह̍ऐः
151.m: O Agni, today with praises, like a horse, like auspicious purpose touching the heart, / may we accomplish your [deeds] with our offerings.

151.s: adhā̱ hya̍gne̱ krato̍rbha̱drasya̱ dakṣa̍sya sā̱dhoḥ | ra̱thīrṛ̱tasya̍ bṛha̱to ba̱bhūtha̍
151.d: अधा̱ ह्य̍ग्ने̱ क्रतो̍र्भ̱द्रस्य̱ दक्ष̍स्य सा̱धोः । र̱थीरृ̱तस्य̍ बृह̱तो ब̱भूथ̍
151.m: For then, O Agni, of auspicious purpose, of straight skill, / you became the charioteer of the great cosmic order.

151.s: e̱bhirno̍ a̱rkairbhavā̍ no a̱rvāṅ svarṇa jyotī̍ḥ | agne̱ viśve̍bhiḥ su̱manā̱ anī̍kaiḥ
151.d: ए̱भिर्नो̍ अ̱र्कैर्भवा̍ नो अ̱र्वाङ् स्वर्ण ज्योती̍ः । अग्ने̱ विश्वे̍भिः सु̱मना̱ अनी̍कैः
151.m: With these our songs be turned toward us, like the light of heaven, / O Agni, favorable with all your faces.

151.s: a̱gnim̐ hotā̍raṃ manye dāsva̍nta̱ṃ vasu̍ṃ sū̱num̐ saha̍so jā̱tave̍dasa̱ṃ vipra̍ṃ na jā̱tave̍dasam ya ū̱rdhvayā̍ svadhva̱ro de̱vo de̱vācyā̍ kṛ̱pā ghṛ̱tasya̱ vibhrā̍ṣṭima̱nu̍vaṣṭi śo̱ciṣāju̍hvā̱nasya̍ sa̱rpiṣa̍ḥ
151.d: अ̱ग्निम्̐ होता̍रं मन्ये दास्व̍न्त̱ं वसु̍ं सू̱नुम्̐ सह̍सो जा̱तवे̍दस̱ं विप्र̍ं न जा̱तवे̍दसम् य ऊ̱र्ध्वया̍ स्वध्व̱रो दे̱वो दे̱वाच्या̍ कृ̱पा घृ̱तस्य̱ विभ्रा̍ष्टिम̱नु̍वष्टि शो̱चिषाजु̍ह्वा̱नस्य̍ स̱र्पिष̍ः
151.m: I regard Agni the Hotṛ, the bounteous, the good, the son of strength, Jātavedas, / like a sage, Jātavedas, / who, performing a good sacrifice, a god with upright, godward-turned form, / desires the radiance of the ghee, through the flame of the melted butter offered into him.

151.s: agne̱ tvaṃ no̱ anta̍ma u̱ta trā̱tā śi̱vo bha̍vā varū̱thya̍ḥ vasu̍ra̱gnirvasu̍śravā̱ acchā̍ nakṣi dyu̱matta̍mam̐ ra̱yindā̍ḥ taṃ tvā̍ śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ su̱mnāya̍ nū̱nama̍īmahe sakhi̍bhyaḥ
151.d: अग्ने̱ त्वं नो̱ अन्त̍म उ̱त त्रा̱ता शि̱वो भ̍वा वरू̱थ्य̍ः वसु̍र̱ग्निर्वसु̍श्रवा̱ अच्छा̍ नक्षि द्यु̱मत्त̍मम्̐ र̱यिन्दा̍ः तं त्वा̍ शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सु̱म्नाय̍ नू̱नम̍ईमहे सखि̍भ्यः
151.m: O Agni, be closest to us and our savior, gracious, a shelter; / good is Agni, possessing good renown; come near, give most bright wealth; / so to you, O most glowing, shining one, we now pray for favor, for our friends.

152.s: (5) yena̱ ṛṣa̍ya̱stapa̍sā sa̱tramāya̱nnindhā̍nā a̱gnim̐ sva̍rā̱bhara̍ntaḥ tasmi̍nna̱haṃ nida̍dhe̱ nāke̍ a̱gniṃ yamā̱hurmana̍va stī̱rṇaba̍rhiṣam
152.d: (5) येन̱ ऋष̍य̱स्तप̍सा स̱त्रमाय̱न्निन्धा̍ना अ̱ग्निम्̐ स्व̍रा̱भर̍न्तः तस्मि̍न्न̱हं निद̍धे̱ नाके̍ अ̱ग्निं यमा̱हुर्मन̍व स्ती̱र्णब̍र्हिषम्
152.m: With which ascetic heat the seers went to the sacrificial session, kindling Agni, bringing heaven, / in that firmament I set Agni, whom mortals call the one of strewn sacrificial grass.

152.s: taṃ patnī̍bhiranu̍ gacchema devāḥ pu̱trairbhrātṛ̍bhiru̱ta vā̱ hira̍ṇyaiḥ nāka̍ṃ gṛbhṇā̱nāḥ su̍kṛ̱tasya̍ lo̱ke tṛ̱tīye̍ pṛ̱ṣṭhe adhi̍roca̱ne di̱vaḥ
152.d: तं पत्नी̍भिरनु̍ गच्छेम देवाः पु̱त्रैर्भ्रातृ̍भिरु̱त वा̱ हिर̍ण्यैः नाक̍ं गृभ्णा̱नाः सु̍कृ̱तस्य̍ लो̱के तृ̱तीये̍ पृ̱ष्ठे अधि̍रोच̱ने दि̱वः
152.m: May we, O gods, follow after him with our wives, sons, brothers, or with gold, / seizing the firmament in the world of good deeds, upon the third surface, in the realm of heaven.

152.s: ā vā̱co madhya̍maruhadbhura̱ṇyu̱raya̱magniḥ satpa̍tiśceki̍tānaḥ pṛ̱ṣṭhe pṛ̍thi̱vyā nihi̍to davi̍dyutadadhaspa̱daṃ kṛ̍ṇutā̱ṃ ye pṛta̍nyava̍ḥ
152.d: आ वा̱चो मध्य̍मरुहद्भुर̱ण्यु̱रय̱मग्निः सत्प̍तिश्चेकि̍तानः पृ̱ष्ठे पृ̍थि̱व्या निहि̍तो दवि̍द्युतदधस्प̱दं कृ̍णुता̱ं ये पृत̍न्यव̍ः
152.m: The supporter mounted the middle of speech, this Agni, lord of the good, observant; / placed upon the back of the earth, flashing, let him cast underfoot those who wage war against us.

152.s: a̱yama̱gnirvī̍ra̱ta̍mo vayo̱dhāḥ sa̍ha̱sriyo̍ dyotatā̱mapra̍yucchan vibhrāja̍mānaḥ sari̱rasya̱ madhya̱ upa̱ prayā̍hi di̱vyāni̱ dhāma̍
152.d: अ̱यम̱ग्निर्वी̍र̱त̍मो वयो̱धाः स̍ह̱स्रियो̍ द्योतता̱मप्र̍युच्छन् विभ्राज̍मानः सरि̱रस्य̱ मध्य̱ उप̱ प्रया̍हि दि̱व्यानि̱ धाम̍
152.m: Let this Agni, most heroic, bestowing vigor, thousandfold, shine without failing; / gleaming brightly in the midst of the water, go forth unto the heavenly domains.

152.s: saṃpracya̍vadhva̱mupa̍ saṃprayā̱tāgne̍ pa̱tho de̍va̱yānā̍n kṛṇudhvam puna̍ḥ kṛṇvā̱nā pi̱tarā̱ yuvā̍nānvātā̍m̐sī̱t tvayi̱ tantu̍me̱tam
152.d: संप्रच्य̍वध्व̱मुप̍ संप्रया̱ताग्ने̍ प̱थो दे̍व̱याना̍न् कृणुध्वम् पुन̍ः कृण्वा̱ना पि̱तरा̱ युवा̍नान्वाता̍म्̐सी̱त् त्वयि̱ तन्तु̍मे̱तम्
152.m: Move together, march forth together; O Agni, make the paths traveled by the gods; / making the two parents young again, he has stretched this thread in you.

152.s: udbu̍dhyasvāgne̱ prati̍jāgṛhi̱ tvami̍ṣṭāpūrte sam̐sṛ̍jethāma̱yaṃ ca̍ a̱smintsa̱dhasthe̱ adhyutta̍rasmi̱n viśve̍ de̱vā yaja̍mānaśca sīdata
152.d: उद्बु̍ध्यस्वाग्ने̱ प्रति̍जागृहि̱ त्वमि̍ष्टापूर्ते सम्̐सृ̍जेथाम̱यं च̍ अ̱स्मिन्त्स̱धस्थे̱ अध्युत्त̍रस्मि̱न् विश्वे̍ दे̱वा यज̍मानश्च सीदत
152.m: Awaken, O Agni; be watchful; unite, both you and this [sacrificer], with the fruits of sacrificial and charitable deeds; / in this seat, upon the higher one, sit down, All-Gods and the sacrificer.

152.s: yena̱ vaha̍si sa̱hasra̱ṃ yenā̍gne sarvaveda̱sam | tene̱maṃ ya̱jñaṃ no̍ naya̱ svarde̱veṣu̱ ganta̍ve
152.d: येन̱ वह̍सि स̱हस्र̱ं येना̍ग्ने सर्ववेद̱सम् । तेने̱मं य̱ज्ञं नो̍ नय̱ स्वर्दे̱वेषु̱ गन्त̍वे
152.m: Wherewith you carry a thousand, wherewith, O Agni, all possessions, / therewith lead this sacrifice of ours to heaven to go among the gods.

152.s: a̱yaṃ te̱ yoni̍rṛ̱tviyo̱ yato̍ jā̱to aro̍cathāḥ | taṃ jā̱nanna̍gna̱ āro̍hāthā̍ no vardhayā ra̱yim
152.d: अ̱यं ते̱ योनि̍रृ̱त्वियो̱ यतो̍ जा̱तो अरो̍चथाः । तं जा̱नन्न̍ग्न̱ आरो̍हाथा̍ नो वर्धया र̱यिम्
152.m: This is your seasonal womb, whence born you shone forth; / knowing that, O Agni, mount it, then increase our wealth.

153.s: tapa̍śca tapa̱sya̍śca̱ śaiśi̍rā ṛ̱tū a̱gnera̍ntaḥśle̱ṣo̍'si kalpe̍tāṃ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī kalpa̍ntā̱māpa̱ oṣa̍dhaya̱ḥ kalpa̍ntāma̱gnaya̱ḥ pṛtha̱ṅ mama̱ jyaiṣṭhyā̍ya̱ savra̍tāḥ ye a̱gnaya̱ḥ sama̍naso̱'ntarā dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī i̱me śaiśi̍rā ṛ̱tū a̱bhikalpa̍mānā̱ indra̍miva de̱vā a̱bhisaṃvi̍śantu̱ tayā̍ de̱vata̍yāṅgira̱svad dhru̱ve sī̍datam para̱me̱ṣṭhī tvā̍ sādayatu di̱vaspṛ̱ṣṭhe jyorti̍ṣmatīm viśva̍smai prā̱ṇāyā̍pā̱nāya̍ vyā̱nāya̱ viśva̱ṃ jyoti̍ryaccha sūrya̍ste'dhipa̱tistayā̍ de̱vata̍yāṅgira̱svad dhru̱vā sī̍da
153.d: तप̍श्च तप̱स्य̍श्च̱ शैशि̍रा ऋ̱तू अ̱ग्नेर̍न्तःश्ले̱षो̍ऽसि कल्पे̍तां द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी कल्प̍न्ता̱माप̱ ओष̍धय̱ः कल्प̍न्ताम̱ग्नय̱ः पृथ̱ङ् मम̱ ज्यैष्ठ्या̍य̱ सव्र̍ताः ये अ̱ग्नय̱ः सम̍नसो̱ऽन्तरा द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी इ̱मे शैशि̍रा ऋ̱तू अ̱भिकल्प̍माना̱ इन्द्र̍मिव दे̱वा अ̱भिसंवि̍शन्तु̱ तया̍ दे̱वत̍याङ्गिर̱स्वद् ध्रु̱वे सी̍दतम् पर̱मे̱ष्ठी त्वा̍ सादयतु दि̱वस्पृ̱ष्ठे ज्योर्ति̍ष्मतीम् विश्व̍स्मै प्रा̱णाया̍पा̱नाय̍ व्या̱नाय̱ विश्व̱ं ज्योति̍र्यच्छ सूर्य̍स्तेऽधिप̱तिस्तया̍ दे̱वत̍याङ्गिर̱स्वद् ध्रु̱वा सी̍द
153.m: Tapas and Tapasya are the two cool seasons; you are the inner bond of Agni. / May heaven and earth be fit; may the waters and the plants be fit; may the fires separately be fit for my primacy, having common vows. / Which fires, like-minded between these heaven and earth, / being fit for the two cool seasons, let them enter together as the gods [enter] Indra; with that deity sit firmly like Aṅgiras. / Let Parameṣṭhin seat you upon the back of heaven, full of light; / for every in-breath, down-breath, diffused breath, bestow all light. / Sūrya is your overlord; with that deity sit firmly like Aṅgiras.

153.s: lo̱kaṃ pṛ̍ṇa chi̱draṃ pṛ̍ṇātho̍ sīda dhru̱vā tvam | indrā̱gnī tvā̱ bṛha̱spati̍ra̱smin yonā̍ asīṣadan
153.d: लो̱कं पृ̍ण छि̱द्रं पृ̍णाथो̍ सीद ध्रु̱वा त्वम् । इन्द्रा̱ग्नी त्वा̱ बृह̱स्पति̍र̱स्मिन् योना̍ असीषदन्
153.m: Fill the space, fill the cleft, and then sit firm; / Indrāgnī and Bṛhaspati have seated you in this womb.

153.s: tā a̍sya sū̱dado̍hasa̱ḥ soma̍m̐ śrīṇanti̱ pṛśna̍yaḥ | janma̍nde̱vānā̱ṃ viśa̍stri̱ṣvāro̍ca̱ne di̱vaḥ
153.d: ता अ̍स्य सू̱ददो̍हस̱ः सोम̍म्̐ श्रीणन्ति̱ पृश्न̍यः । जन्म̍न्दे̱वाना̱ं विश̍स्त्रि̱ष्वारो̍च̱ने दि̱वः
153.m: The spotted cows of good yield blend his Soma, / at the birth of the gods, the clans in the three realms of heaven.

153.s: indra̱ṃ viśvā̍ avīvṛdhantsamu̱dravya̍casa̱ṃ gira̍ḥ | ra̱thītama̍m̐ ra̱thīnā̱ṃ vājā̍nām̐ satpa̍ti̱ṃ pati̍m
153.d: इन्द्र̱ं विश्वा̍ अवीवृधन्त्समु̱द्रव्य̍चस̱ं गिर̍ः । र̱थीतम̍म्̐ र̱थीना̱ं वाजा̍नाम्̐ सत्प̍ति̱ं पति̍म्
153.m: All songs have magnified Indra, wide as the ocean, / best of charioteers among charioteers, lord of the good, lord of vital vigors.

153.s: protha̱daśvo̱ na yava̍se'viṣya̱nyadā maha̱ḥ saṃvara̍ṇādvyasthā̍t āda̍sya̱ vāto̱ anu̍vāti śo̱ciradha̍ sma te vra̱jana̍ṃ kṛ̱ṣṇama̍sti
153.d: प्रोथ̱दश्वो̱ न यव̍सेऽविष्य̱न्यदा मह̱ः संवर̍णाद्व्यस्था̍त् आद̍स्य̱ वातो̱ अनु̍वाति शो̱चिरध̍ स्म ते व्र̱जन̍ं कृ̱ष्णम̍स्ति
153.m: Snorting like a horse longing for pasture, when he burst forth from the great enclosure, / then the wind blows after his flame; then indeed your track is black.

153.s: ā̱yoṣṭvā̱ sada̍ne sādayāmyava̍taśchā̱yāyā̍m̐ samu̱drasya̱ hṛda̍ye ra̱śmīva̍tīṃ bhāsva̍tīmā yā dyāṃ bhāsyāpṛ̍thi̱vīmorva̱ntari̍kṣam para̱me̱ṣṭhī tvā̍ sādayatu di̱vaspṛ̱ṣṭhe vyaca̍svatīṃ pratha̍svatīm | diva̍ṃ yaccha̱ diva̍ṃ dṛm̐ha̱ diva̱ṃ mā hi̍ṃm̐sīḥ viśva̍smai prā̱ṇāyā̍pā̱nāya̍ vyā̱nāyo̍dā̱nāya̍ prati̱ṣṭhāyai̍ ca̱ritrāya sūrya̍stvābhipā̍tu ma̱hyā sva̱styā cha̱rdiṣā̱ śanta̍mena̱ tayā̍ de̱vata̍yāṅgira̱svad dhru̱ve sī̍datam
153.d: आ̱योष्ट्वा̱ सद̍ने सादयाम्यव̍तश्छा̱याया̍म्̐ समु̱द्रस्य̱ हृद̍ये र̱श्मीव̍तीं भास्व̍तीमा या द्यां भास्यापृ̍थि̱वीमोर्व̱न्तरि̍क्षम् पर̱मे̱ष्ठी त्वा̍ सादयतु दि̱वस्पृ̱ष्ठे व्यच̍स्वतीं प्रथ̍स्वतीम् । दिव̍ं यच्छ̱ दिव̍ं दृम्̐ह̱ दिव̱ं मा हि̍ंम्̐सीः विश्व̍स्मै प्रा̱णाया̍पा̱नाय̍ व्या̱नायो̍दा̱नाय̍ प्रति̱ष्ठायै̍ च̱रित्राय सूर्य̍स्त्वाभिपा̍तु म̱ह्या स्व̱स्त्या छ̱र्दिषा̱ शन्त̍मेन̱ तया̍ दे̱वत̍याङ्गिर̱स्वद् ध्रु̱वे सी̍दतम्
153.m: I seat you in the seat of the living, in the shade of the pit, in the heart of the ocean, / beaming with rays, shining, which shine upon heaven, upon earth, and wide mid-air. / Let Parameṣṭhin seat you upon the back of heaven, wide-reaching, spreading abroad; sustain heaven, make heaven firm, do not harm heaven; / for every in-breath, down-breath, diffused breath, up-breath, for stability, for walking; / let Sūrya protect you with great well-being, with most wholesome shelter; with that deity sit firmly like Aṅgiras.

153.s: sa̱hasra̍sya pramā̱si̍ sa̱hasra̍sya prati̱māsi̍ sa̱hasra̍syonmā̱si̍ | sāha̱sro̍'si sa̱hasrā̍ya tvā
153.d: स̱हस्र̍स्य प्रमा̱सि̍ स̱हस्र̍स्य प्रति̱मासि̍ स̱हस्र̍स्योन्मा̱सि̍ । साह̱स्रो̍ऽसि स̱हस्रा̍य त्वा
153.m: You are the measure of a thousand, you are the counterpart of a thousand, you are the upward measure of a thousand; / belonging to a thousand are you; for a thousand [I take] you.

"Agne jātān", eight. "Raśminā satyāya", seven. "Rājñyasi", fifteen. "Ayaṃ puraḥ", ten.
"Agnirmūrdhā", thirty. "Yena ṛṣayaḥ", eight. "Tapaśca", seven.
Eighty-five [kaṇḍikās] in the seven anuvākas.
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

153.s:
agnimūrdhā triṃśat
yena ṛṣayo'ṣṭa
tapaśca sapta
153.d:
अग्निमूर्धा त्रिंशत्
येन ऋषयोऽष्ट
तपश्च सप्त

154.s: nama̍ste rudra ma̱nyava̍ u̱to ta̱ iṣa̍ve̱ nama̍ḥ | bā̱hubhyā̍mu̱ta te̱ nama̍ḥ
154.d: नम̍स्ते रुद्र म̱न्यव̍ उ̱तो त̱ इष̍वे̱ नम̍ः । बा̱हुभ्या̍मु̱त ते̱ नम̍ः
154.m: Homage, o Rudra, to your wrath, and homage to your arrow; / and homage to your two arms.

154.s: yā te̍ rudra śi̱vā ta̱nūragho̱rāpā̍pakāśinī | tayā̍ nasta̱nvā̱ śanta̍mayā̱ giriśantā̱bhicā̍kaśīhi
154.d: या ते̍ रुद्र शि̱वा त̱नूरघो̱रापा̍पकाशिनी । तया̍ नस्त̱न्वा̱ शन्त̍मया̱ गिरिशन्ता̱भिचा̍कशीहि
154.m: That body of yours, o Rudra, which is auspicious, un-terrific, revealing no evil, / with that most beneficent body, o mountain-dwelling bestower of peace, look upon us.

154.s: yāmiṣu̍ṃ giriśanta̱ haste̱ bibha̱rṣyasta̍ve | śi̱vāṃ gi̍ritra̱ tāṃ ku̍ru̱ mā hi̍ṃm̐sī̱ḥ puru̍ṣa̱ṃ jaga̍t
154.d: यामिषु̍ं गिरिशन्त̱ हस्ते̱ बिभ̱र्ष्यस्त̍वे । शि̱वां गि̍रित्र̱ तां कु̍रु̱ मा हि̍ंम्̐सी̱ः पुरु̍ष̱ं जग̍त्
154.m: The arrow, o mountain-dwelling bestower of peace, which you bear in your hand to discharge, / make it auspicious, o mountain-protector; do not harm man [or] moving creature.

154.s: śi̱vena̱ vaca̍sā tvā̱ giriśācchā̍ vadāmasi | yathā̍ na̱ḥ sarva̱mijjaga̍daya̱kṣmam̐ sumanā̱ asa̍t
154.d: शि̱वेन̱ वच̍सा त्वा̱ गिरिशाच्छा̍ वदामसि । यथा̍ न̱ः सर्व̱मिज्जग̍दय̱क्ष्मम्̐ सुमना̱ अस̍त्
154.m: With auspicious speech we address you, o mountain-dweller, / that all our moving creatures may be free from disease and of good cheer.

154.s: a̱dhya̍vocadadhiva̱ktā pra̍tha̱mo daivyo̍ bhi̱ṣak ahī̍m̐śca̱ sarvā̍ñja̱mbhaya̱ntsarvā̍śca yātudhānyau̍'varācīḥ parā̍suva
154.d: अ̱ध्य̍वोचदधिव̱क्ता प्र̍थ̱मो दैव्यो̍ भि̱षक् अही̍म्̐श्च̱ सर्वा̍ञ्ज̱म्भय̱न्त्सर्वा̍श्च यातुधान्यौ̍ऽवराचीः परा̍सुव
154.m: May the advocate speak on our behalf, the first divine physician. / Crushing all serpents and all sorceresses, drive them away downward.

154.s: a̱sau yastā̱mro a̍ru̱ṇa u̱ta ba̱bhruḥ su̍ma̱ṅgala̍ḥ ye caina̍m̐ru̱drā a̱bhito̍ di̱kṣu śri̱tāḥ sa̍hasra̱śo'vai̍ṣām̐ heḷa̍ īmahe
154.d: अ̱सौ यस्ता̱म्रो अ̍रु̱ण उ̱त ब̱भ्रुः सु̍म̱ङ्गल̍ः ये चैन̍म्̐रु̱द्रा अ̱भितो̍ दि̱क्षु श्रि̱ताः स̍हस्र̱शोऽवै̍षाम्̐ हेऌअ̍ ईमहे
154.m: Yonder one who is copper-red, ruddy, and brown, highly auspicious, / and the Rudras who dwell around him in the quarters by thousands: their wrath we deprecate.

154.s: a̱sau yo̍'va̱sarpa̍ti nīlagrī̱vo vilo̍hitaḥ u̱taina̍ṃ go̱pā a̍dṛśra̱nnadṛ̍śrannudahā̱rya̍ḥ sa dṛ̱ṣṭo mṛ̍ḷayāti naḥ
154.d: अ̱सौ यो̍ऽव̱सर्प̍ति नीलग्री̱वो विलो̍हितः उ̱तैन̍ं गो̱पा अ̍दृश्र̱न्नदृ̍श्रन्नुदहा̱र्य̍ः स दृ̱ष्टो मृ̍ऌअयाति नः
154.m: Yonder one who glides down, blue-necked, deep-red, / even the cowherds saw him, the water-fetching maidens saw him; seen, may he be gracious to us.

154.s: namo̍'stu nīlagrī̱vāya̍ sahasrā̱kṣāya̍ mī̱ḍhuṣe̍ atho̱ ye a̍sya̱ satvā̍no̱'haṃ tebhyo̍'kara̱ṃ nama̍ḥ
154.d: नमो̍ऽस्तु नीलग्री̱वाय̍ सहस्रा̱क्षाय̍ मी̱ढुषे̍ अथो̱ ये अ̍स्य̱ सत्वा̍नो̱ऽहं तेभ्यो̍ऽकर̱ं नम̍ः
154.m: Homage be to the blue-necked, thousand-eyed bountiful one; / and those who are his warriors, to them I have paid homage.

154.s: pramu̍ṃñca̱ dhanva̍na̱stvamu̱bhayo̱rārtnyo̱rjyām | yāśca̍ te̱ hasta̱ iṣa̍va̱ḥ parā̱ tā bha̍gavo vapa
154.d: प्रमु̍ंञ्च̱ धन्व̍न̱स्त्वमु̱भयो̱रार्त्न्यो̱र्ज्याम् । याश्च̍ ते̱ हस्त̱ इष̍व̱ः परा̱ ता भ̍गवो वप
154.m: Unstring the bowstring from both ends of your bow; / and those arrows that are in your hand, cast them away, o bountiful lord.

154.s: vijya̱ṃ dhanu̍ḥ kapa̱rdino̱ viśa̍lyo̱ bāṇa̍vām̐2 u̱ta ane̍śannasya̱ yā iṣa̍va ā̱bhura̍sya niṣa̱ṅgathi̍ḥ
154.d: विज्य̱ं धनु̍ः कप̱र्दिनो̱ विश̍ल्यो̱ बाण̍वाम्̐2 उ̱त अने̍शन्नस्य̱ या इष̍व आ̱भुर̍स्य निष̱ङ्गथि̍ः
154.m: Stringless be the bow of the one with braided hair, and without point be his arrow-shaft; / vanished be his arrows, harmless his quiver.

154.s: pari̍ te̱ dhanva̍no he̱tira̱smānvṛ̍ṇaktu vi̱śvata̍ḥ | atho̱ ya i̍ṣu̱dhistavā̱re a̱smannidhe̍hi̱ tam
154.d: परि̍ ते̱ धन्व̍नो हे̱तिर̱स्मान्वृ̍णक्तु वि̱श्वत̍ः । अथो̱ य इ̍षु̱धिस्तवा̱रे अ̱स्मन्निधे̍हि̱ तम्
154.m: May the missile of your bow avoid us on all sides; / and that quiver of yours, deposit it far away from us.

154.s: yā te̍ he̱tirmī̍ḍhuṣṭama̱ haste̍ ba̱bhūva̍ te̱ dhanu̍ḥ | tayā̱smānvi̱śvata̱stvama̍ya̱kṣmayā̱ pari̍bhuja
154.d: या ते̍ हे̱तिर्मी̍ढुष्टम̱ हस्ते̍ ब̱भूव̍ ते̱ धनु̍ः । तया̱स्मान्वि̱श्वत̱स्त्वम̍य̱क्ष्मया̱ परि̍भुज
154.m: That missile of yours, o most bountiful one, that bow which was in your hand, / with that, harmless, protect us on all sides.

154.s: ava̍tatya̱ dhanu̱ṣṭvam̐ sa̍hasrākṣa śa̱teṣu̍dhe | ni̱śīrya̍ śa̱lyānā̱ṃ mukhā̍ śi̱vo na̍ḥ su̱manā̍ bhava
154.d: अव̍तत्य̱ धनु̱ष्ट्वम्̐ स̍हस्राक्ष श̱तेषु̍धे । नि̱शीर्य̍ श̱ल्याना̱ं मुखा̍ शि̱वो न̍ः सु̱मना̍ भव
154.m: Having unstrung your bow, o thousand-eyed one of a hundred quivers, / having blunted the tips of your arrows, be auspicious and well-disposed to us.

154.s: nama̍sta̱ āyu̍dhāyānā̍tatāya dhṛ̱ṣṇave̍ | u̱bhābhyā̍mu̱ta te̱ namo̍ bā̱hubhyā̱ṃ tava̱ dhanva̍ne
154.d: नम̍स्त̱ आयु̍धायाना̍तताय धृ̱ष्णवे̍ । उ̱भाभ्या̍मु̱त ते̱ नमो̍ बा̱हुभ्या̱ं तव̱ धन्व̍ने
154.m:
Homage to your weapon, unstrung and bold;
and homage to both your arms, to your bow!

154.s: mā no̍ ma̱hānta̍mu̱ta mā no̍ arbha̱kaṃ mā na̱ ukṣa̍ntamu̱ta mā na̍ ukṣi̱tam mā no̍ vadhīḥ pi̱tara̱ṃ mota mā̱tara̱ṃ mā na̍ḥ pri̱yāsta̱nvo̍ rudra rīriṣaḥ
154.d: मा नो̍ म̱हान्त̍मु̱त मा नो̍ अर्भ̱कं मा न̱ उक्ष̍न्तमु̱त मा न̍ उक्षि̱तम् मा नो̍ वधीः पि̱तर̱ं मोत मा̱तर̱ं मा न̍ः प्रि̱यास्त̱न्वो̍ रुद्र रीरिषः
154.m:
Do not harm our great one or our small one, neither our growing child nor our grown youth;
do not strike our father or our mother, do not harm our dear bodies, O Rudra!

154.s: mā na̍sto̱ke tana̍ye̱ mā na̱ āyu̍ṣi̱ mā no̱ goṣu̱ mā no̱ aśve̍ṣu rīriṣaḥ mā no̍ vī̱rān ru̍dra bhā̱mino̍ vadhīrha̱viṣma̍ntaḥ sada̱mit tvā̍ havāmahe
154.d: मा न̍स्तो̱के तन̍ये̱ मा न̱ आयु̍षि̱ मा नो̱ गोषु̱ मा नो̱ अश्वे̍षु रीरिषः मा नो̍ वी̱रान् रु̍द्र भा̱मिनो̍ वधीर्ह̱विष्म̍न्तः सद̱मित् त्वा̍ हवामहे
154.m:
Do not harm our seed or offspring, nor our life, nor our cows, nor our horses;
do not strike down our men in anger, O Rudra! Offering oblations, we call upon you constantly.

155.s: (1) namo̍ hiraṇyabāhave senā̱nye̍ di̱śāṃ ca̱ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ namo̍ vṛ̱kṣebhyo̱ hari̍keśebhyaḥ paśū̱nāṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍ḥ nama̍ḥ śa̱ṣpiñja̍rāya̱ tviṣī̍mate pathī̱nāṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ namo̍ harī̍keśāyopavī̱tine̍ puṣṭānā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍ḥ
155.d: (1) नमो̍ हिरण्यबाहवे सेना̱न्ये̍ दि̱शां च̱ पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ वृ̱क्षेभ्यो̱ हरि̍केशेभ्यः पशू̱नां पत̍ये̱ नम̍ः नम̍ः श̱ष्पिञ्ज̍राय̱ त्विषी̍मते पथी̱नां पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ हरी̍केशायोपवी̱तिने̍ पुष्टाना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍ः
155.m:
Homage to the golden-armed commander, the lord of the quarters, homage! Homage to the green-haired trees, homage to the lord of cattle!
Homage to the yellow-green, the radiant lord of paths, homage! Homage to the green-haired, sacred-cord-wearing lord of the well-nourished, homage!

155.s: namo̍ ba̱bhruśā̍yāvyā̱dhine̍'nnā̍nā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ namo̍ bha̱vasya̍ he̱tyai jaga̍tā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍ḥ namo̍ ru̱drāyā̍tatā̱yine̱ kṣetrā̍ṇā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ nama̍ḥ sū̱tāyāha̍ntyai vanā̍nā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍ḥ
155.d: नमो̍ ब̱भ्रुशा̍याव्या̱धिने̍ऽन्ना̍ना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ भ̱वस्य̍ हे̱त्यै जग̍ता̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍ः नमो̍ रु̱द्राया̍तता̱यिने̱ क्षेत्रा̍णा̱ं पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नम̍ः सू̱तायाह̍न्त्यै वना̍ना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍ः
155.m:
Homage to the brown-red, piercing lord of foods, homage! Homage to the missile of Bhava, homage to the lord of moving beings!
Homage to Rudra, with bow drawn, lord of fields, homage! Homage to the charioteer who is inviolable, homage to the lord of forests!

155.s: namo̱ rohi̍tāya stha̱pata̍ye vṛkṣā̱ṇāṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ namo̍ bhu̱vanta̍ye vārivaskṛ̱tāyauṣa̍dhīnā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍ḥ namo̍ ma̱ntriṇe̍ vāṇi̱jāya̱ kakṣā̍ṇā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ nama̍ u̱ccairgho̍ṣāyākra̱ndaya̍te pattī̱nāṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍ḥ
155.d: नमो̱ रोहि̍ताय स्थ̱पत̍ये वृक्षा̱णां पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ भु̱वन्त̍ये वारिवस्कृ̱तायौष̍धीना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍ः नमो̍ म̱न्त्रिणे̍ वाणि̱जाय̱ कक्षा̍णा̱ं पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नम̍ उ̱च्चैर्घो̍षायाक्र̱न्दय̍ते पत्ती̱नां पत̍ये̱ नम̍ः
155.m:
Homage to the red architect, lord of trees, homage! Homage to the bringer of prosperity, the clearing-maker, homage to the lord of plants!
Homage to the counselor, the merchant, lord of coppices, homage! Homage to the loud-voiced, shouting lord of foot-soldiers, homage!

155.s: nama̍: kṛtsnāya̱tāya̱ dhāva̍te̱ satva̍nā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ nama̍ḥ saha̍mānāya nivyā̱dhina̍ āvyā̱dhinī̍nā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍: nama̍: kaku̱bhāya̍ niṣa̱ṅgiṇe̍ ste̱nānā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ namo̍ nice̱rave̍ parica̱rāyāra̍ṇyānā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍:
155.d: नम̍: कृत्स्नाय̱ताय̱ धाव̍ते̱ सत्व̍ना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नम̍ः सह̍मानाय निव्या̱धिन̍ आव्या̱धिनी̍ना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍: नम̍: ककु̱भाय̍ निष̱ङ्गिणे̍ स्ते̱नाना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ निचे̱रवे̍ परिच̱रायार̍ण्याना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍:
155.m:
Homage to him who stretches fully, who runs, lord of warriors, homage! Homage to the overpowering, piercing lord of piercing forces, homage!
Homage to the towering, sword-bearing lord of thieves, homage! Homage to the roamer, the wanderer, homage to the lord of wildernesses!

155.s: namo̱ vañca̍te pari̱vañca̍te stāyū̱nāṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ namo̍ niṣa̱ṅgiṇa̍ iṣudhi̱mate̱ taska̍rāṇā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍: nama̍: sṛkā̱yibhyo̱ jighā̍ṃm̐sadbhyo muṣṇa̱tāṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ namo̍'si̱madbhyo̱ nakta̱ñcara̍dbhyo vikṛnta̱ānā̱ṃ pata̍ye̱ nama̍:
155.d: नमो̱ वञ्च̍ते परि̱वञ्च̍ते स्तायू̱नां पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ निष̱ङ्गिण̍ इषुधि̱मते̱ तस्क̍राणा̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍: नम̍: सृका̱यिभ्यो̱ जिघा̍ंम्̐सद्भ्यो मुष्ण̱तां पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ऽसि̱मद्भ्यो̱ नक्त̱ञ्चर̍द्भ्यो विकृन्त̱आना̱ं पत̍ये̱ नम̍:
155.m:
Homage to the cheat, to the deceiver, lord of stealers, homage! Homage to the sword-bearer with quiver, lord of robbers, homage!
Homage to the missile-armed, seeking to slay, lord of plunderers, homage! Homage to the sword-wielders roaming by night, homage to the lord of murderers!

156.s: (2) nama̍ uṣṇī̱ṣiṇe̍ girica̱rāya̍ kuluñcā̱nāṃ pata̍ye̱ namo̱ nama̱ iṣu̍madbhyo dhanvā̱yibhya̍śca vo̱ nama̍: nama̍ ātanvā̱nebhya̍: prati̱dadhā̍nebhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ nama̍ ā̱yaccha̍dbhyo'sya̍dbhyaśca vo̱ nama̍:
156.d: (2) नम̍ उष्णी̱षिणे̍ गिरिच̱राय̍ कुलुञ्चा̱नां पत̍ये̱ नमो̱ नम̱ इषु̍मद्भ्यो धन्वा̱यिभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नम̍: नम̍ आतन्वा̱नेभ्य̍: प्रति̱दधा̍नेभ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नम̍ आ̱यच्छ̍द्भ्योऽस्य̍द्भ्यश्च वो̱ नम̍:
156.m:
Homage to the turbaned mountain-roamer, lord of sneak-thieves, homage! Homage to you who bear arrows and to you who carry bows, homage to you!
Homage to you who string [the bow] and to you who fit [the arrow], homage to you! Homage to you who draw [the bow] and to you who shoot, homage to you!

156.s: namo̍ visṛ̱jadbhyo̱ vidhya̍dbhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ nama̍: sva̱padbhyo̱ jāgra̍dbhyaśca vo̱ nama̍: nama̱: śayā̍nebhya̱ āsī̍nebhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ nama̱stiṣṭha̍dbhyo̱ dhāva̍dbhyaśca vo̱ nama̍:
156.d: नमो̍ विसृ̱जद्भ्यो̱ विध्य̍द्भ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नम̍: स्व̱पद्भ्यो̱ जाग्र̍द्भ्यश्च वो̱ नम̍: नम̱: शया̍नेभ्य̱ आसी̍नेभ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नम̱स्तिष्ठ̍द्भ्यो̱ धाव̍द्भ्यश्च वो̱ नम̍:
156.m:
Homage to you who discharge and to you who pierce, homage to you! Homage to you who sleep and to you who wake, homage to you!
Homage to you who lie down and to you who sit, homage to you! Homage to you who stand and to you who run, homage to you!

156.s: nama̍: sa̱bhābhya̍: sa̱bhāpa̍tibhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ namo̱'śvebhyo̱'śvapa̍tibhyaśca vo̱ nama̍: nama̍ āvyā̱dhinī̍bhyo vi̱vidhya̍ntībhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ nama̱ uga̍ṇābhyastṛm̐ha̱tībhya̍śca vo̱ nama̍:
156.d: नम̍: स̱भाभ्य̍: स̱भाप̍तिभ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नमो̱ऽश्वेभ्यो̱ऽश्वप̍तिभ्यश्च वो̱ नम̍: नम̍ आव्या̱धिनी̍भ्यो वि̱विध्य̍न्तीभ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नम̱ उग̍णाभ्यस्तृम्̐ह̱तीभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नम̍:
156.m:
Homage to assemblies and to you presidents of assemblies, homage to you! Homage to horses and to you masters of horses, homage to you!
Homage to you piercing and penetrating ones, homage to you! Homage to you troops and crushing forces, homage to you!

156.s: namo̍ ga̱ṇebhyo̍ ga̱ṇapa̍tibhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ namo̱ vrāte̍bhyo̱ vrāta̍patibhyaśca vo̱ nama̍: namo̱ gṛtse̍bhyo̱ gṛtsa̍patibhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ namo̱ virū̍pebhyo vi̱śvarū̍pebhyaśca vo̱ nama̍:
156.d: नमो̍ ग̱णेभ्यो̍ ग̱णप̍तिभ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नमो̱ व्राते̍भ्यो̱ व्रात̍पतिभ्यश्च वो̱ नम̍: नमो̱ गृत्से̍भ्यो̱ गृत्स̍पतिभ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नमो̱ विरू̍पेभ्यो वि̱श्वरू̍पेभ्यश्च वो̱ नम̍:
156.m:
Homage to troops and to you leaders of troops, homage to you! Homage to bands and to you lords of bands, homage to you!
Homage to wise ones and to you lords of the wise, homage to you! Homage to multiform ones and to you having all forms, homage to you!

156.s: nama̱: senā̍bhya: senā̱nibhya̍śca vo̱ namo̱ namo̍ ra̱thibhyo̍ a̱rathebhya̍śca vo̱ nama̍: nama̍: kṣa̱ttṛbhya̍ saṅgrahī̱tṛbhya̍śca vo̱ namo̱ namo̍ ma̱hadbhyo̍ arbha̱kebhya̍śca vo̱ nama̍:
156.d: नम̱: सेना̍भ्य: सेना̱निभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ र̱थिभ्यो̍ अ̱रथेभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नम̍: नम̍: क्ष̱त्तृभ्य̍ सङ्ग्रही̱तृभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ म̱हद्भ्यो̍ अर्भ̱केभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नम̍:
156.m:
Homage to armies and to you commanders of armies, homage to you! Homage to charioteers and to you who are without chariots, homage to you!
Homage to carvers and to you charioteers, homage to you! Homage to great ones and to you little ones, homage to you!

157.s: (3)26 nama̱stakṣa̍bhyo rathakā̱rebhya̍śca vo̱ namo̱ nama̱: kulā̍lebhya: ka̱rmāre̍bhyaśca vo̱ nama̍: namo̍ niṣā̱debhya̍: puñji̱ṣṭhebhya̍śca vo̱ namo̱ nama̍: śva̱nibhyo̍ mṛga̱yubhya̍śca vo̱ nama̍:
157.d: (3)26 नम̱स्तक्ष̍भ्यो रथका̱रेभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नमो̱ नम̱: कुला̍लेभ्य: क̱र्मारे̍भ्यश्च वो̱ नम̍: नमो̍ निषा̱देभ्य̍: पुञ्जि̱ष्ठेभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नमो̱ नम̍: श्व̱निभ्यो̍ मृग̱युभ्य̍श्च वो̱ नम̍:
157.m:
Homage to carpenters and to you chariot-makers, homage to you! Homage to potters and to you blacksmiths, homage to you!
Homage to Niṣādas and to you Puñjiṣṭhas, homage to you! Homage to dog-keepers and to you hunters, homage to you!

157.s: nama̱: śvabhya̱: śvapa̍tibhyaśca vo̱ namo̱ namo̍ bha̱vāya̍ ca ru̱drāya̍ ca nama̍: śa̱rvāya̍ ca paśu̱pata̍ye ca̱ namo̱ nīla̍grīvāya ca śiti̱kaṇṭhā̍ya ca
157.d: नम̱: श्वभ्य̱: श्वप̍तिभ्यश्च वो̱ नमो̱ नमो̍ भ̱वाय̍ च रु̱द्राय̍ च नम̍: श̱र्वाय̍ च पशु̱पत̍ये च̱ नमो̱ नील̍ग्रीवाय च शिति̱कण्ठा̍य च
157.m:
Homage to dogs and to you masters of dogs, homage to you! Homage both to Bhava and to Rudra;
homage both to Śarva and to the lord of cattle, and homage both to the blue-necked and to the white-throated one!

157.s: nama̍: kapa̱rdine̍ ca̱ vyu̍ptakeśāya ca̱ nama̍: sahasrā̱kṣāya̍ ca śa̱tadha̍nvane ca namo̍ giriśa̱yāya̍ ca śipivi̱ṣṭāya̍ ca̱ namo̍ mī̱ḍhuṣṭa̍māya̱ ceṣu̍mate ca
157.d: नम̍: कप̱र्दिने̍ च̱ व्यु̍प्तकेशाय च̱ नम̍: सहस्रा̱क्षाय̍ च श̱तध̍न्वने च नमो̍ गिरिश̱याय̍ च शिपिवि̱ष्टाय̍ च̱ नमो̍ मी̱ढुष्ट̍माय̱ चेषु̍मते च

157.s: namo̍ hra̱svāya̍ ca vāma̱nāya̍ ca̱ namo̍ bṛha̱te ca̱ varṣī̍yase ca namo̍ vṛ̱ddhāya̍ ca sa̱ṃvṛdhve̍ ca̱ namo̱'gryāya̍ ca pratha̱māya̍ ca
157.d: नमो̍ ह्र̱स्वाय̍ च वाम̱नाय̍ च̱ नमो̍ बृह̱ते च̱ वर्षी̍यसे च नमो̍ वृ̱द्धाय̍ च स̱ंवृध्वे̍ च̱ नमो̱ऽग्र्याय̍ च प्रथ̱माय̍ च

157.s: nama̍ ā̱śave̍ cāji̱rāya̍ ca̱ nama̱: śīghriyā̍ya ca̱ śībhyā̍ya ca nama̱ ūrmyā̍ya cāvasva̱nyā̍ya ca̱ namo̍ nāde̱yāya̍ ca dvī̱pyā̍ya ca
157.d: नम̍ आ̱शवे̍ चाजि̱राय̍ च̱ नम̱: शीघ्रिया̍य च̱ शीभ्या̍य च नम̱ ऊर्म्या̍य चावस्व̱न्या̍य च̱ नमो̍ नादे̱याय̍ च द्वी̱प्या̍य च

158.s: namo̍ jye̱ṣṭhāya̍ ca kani̱ṣṭhāya̍ ca̱ nama̍ḥ pūrva̱jāya̍ cāpara̱jāya̍ ca namo̍ madhya̱māya̍ cāpaga̱lbhāya̍ ca̱ namo̍ jagha̱nyā̍ya ca bu̱dhnyā̍ya ca
158.d: नमो̍ ज्ये̱ष्ठाय̍ च कनि̱ष्ठाय̍ च̱ नम̍ः पूर्व̱जाय̍ चापर̱जाय̍ च नमो̍ मध्य̱माय̍ चापग̱ल्भाय̍ च̱ नमो̍ जघ̱न्या̍य च बु̱ध्न्या̍य च

158.s: nama̍ḥ so̱bhyāya̍ ca pratisa̱ryā̍ya ca̱ namo̱ yāmyā̍ya ca̱ kṣemyā̍ya ca nama̍ḥ ślokyā̍ya cāvasā̱nyā̍ya ca̱ nama̍ u̱rvaryā̍ya ca̱ khalyā̍ya ca
158.d: नम̍ः सो̱भ्याय̍ च प्रतिस̱र्या̍य च̱ नमो̱ याम्या̍य च̱ क्षेम्या̍य च नम̍ः श्लोक्या̍य चावसा̱न्या̍य च̱ नम̍ उ̱र्वर्या̍य च̱ खल्या̍य च

158.s: namo̱ vanyā̍ya ca̱ kakṣyā̍ya ca̱ nama̍ḥ śra̱vāya̍ ca pratiśra̱vāya̍ ca nama̍ ā̱śuṣe̍ṇāya cā̱śura̍thāya ca̱ nama̱ḥ śūrā̍ya cāvabhe̱dine̍ ca
158.d: नमो̱ वन्या̍य च̱ कक्ष्या̍य च̱ नम̍ः श्र̱वाय̍ च प्रतिश्र̱वाय̍ च नम̍ आ̱शुषे̍णाय चा̱शुर̍थाय च̱ नम̱ः शूरा̍य चावभे̱दिने̍ च

158.s: namo̍ bi̱lmine̍ ca kava̱cine̍ ca̱ namo̍ va̱rmiṇe̍ ca varū̱thine̍ ca nama̍ḥ śru̱tāya̍ ca śrutase̱nāya̍ ca̱ namo̍ dundu̱bhyāya̍ cāhana̱nyā̍ya ca
158.d: नमो̍ बि̱ल्मिने̍ च कव̱चिने̍ च̱ नमो̍ व̱र्मिणे̍ च वरू̱थिने̍ च नम̍ः श्रु̱ताय̍ च श्रुतसे̱नाय̍ च̱ नमो̍ दुन्दु̱भ्याय̍ चाहन̱न्या̍य च

158.s: namo̍ dhṛṣṇa̱ve̍ ca pramṛ̱śāya̍ ca̱ namo̍ niṣa̱ṅgiṇe̍ ceṣudhi̱mate̍ ca nama̍stī̱kṣṇeṣa̍ve cāyu̱dhine̍ ca̱ nama̍ḥ svāyu̱dhāya̍ ca sudhanva̍ne ca
158.d: नमो̍ धृष्ण̱वे̍ च प्रमृ̱शाय̍ च̱ नमो̍ निष̱ङ्गिणे̍ चेषुधि̱मते̍ च नम̍स्ती̱क्ष्णेष̍वे चायु̱धिने̍ च̱ नम̍ः स्वायु̱धाय̍ च सुधन्व̍ने च

159.s: (5) nama̱ḥ srutyā̍ya ca̱ pathyā̍ya ca̱ nama̍ḥ kā̱ṭyā̍ya ca̱ nīpyā̍ya ca nama̱ḥ kulyā̍ya ca sara̱syā̍ya ca̱ namo̍ nāde̱yāya̍ ca vaiśa̱ntāya̍ ca
159.d: (5) नम̱ः स्रुत्या̍य च̱ पथ्या̍य च̱ नम̍ः का̱ट्या̍य च̱ नीप्या̍य च नम̱ः कुल्या̍य च सर̱स्या̍य च̱ नमो̍ नादे̱याय̍ च वैश̱न्ताय̍ च

159.s: nama̱ḥ kūpyā̍ya cāva̱ṭyā̍ya ca̱ nama̱ īdhyā̍ya cāta̱pyā̍ya ca namo̱ meghyā̍ya ca vidyu̱tyā̍ya ca̱ namo̍ va̱rṣyāya̍ cāva̱rṣyāya̍ ca
159.d: नम̱ः कूप्या̍य चाव̱ट्या̍य च̱ नम̱ ईध्या̍य चात̱प्या̍य च नमो̱ मेघ्या̍य च विद्यु̱त्या̍य च̱ नमो̍ व̱र्ष्याय̍ चाव̱र्ष्याय̍ च

159.s: namo̱ vātyā̍ya ca̱ reṣmyā̍ya ca̱ namo̍ vāsta̱vyā̍ya ca vāstu̱pāya̍ ca nama̱ḥ somā̍ya ca ru̱drāya̍ ca̱ nama̍stā̱mrāya̍ cāru̱ṇāya̍ ca
159.d: नमो̱ वात्या̍य च̱ रेष्म्या̍य च̱ नमो̍ वास्त̱व्या̍य च वास्तु̱पाय̍ च नम̱ः सोमा̍य च रु̱द्राय̍ च̱ नम̍स्ता̱म्राय̍ चारु̱णाय̍ च

159.s: nama̍ḥ śa̱ṅgave̍ ca paśu̱pata̍ye ca̱ nama̍ u̱grāya̍ ca bhī̱māya̍ ca namo̍'greva̱dhāya̍ ca dūreva̱dhāya̍ ca̱ namo̍ ha̱ntre ca̱ hanī̍yase ca
159.d: नम̍ः श̱ङ्गवे̍ च पशु̱पत̍ये च̱ नम̍ उ̱ग्राय̍ च भी̱माय̍ च नमो̍ऽग्रेव̱धाय̍ च दूरेव̱धाय̍ च̱ नमो̍ ह̱न्त्रे च̱ हनी̍यसे च

159.s: namo̍ vṛ̱kṣebhyo̱ hari̍keśebhyo̱ nama̍stā̱rāya̍ nama̍ḥ śa̱mbhave̍ ca mayo̱bhave̍ ca̱ nama̍ḥ śaṅka̱rāya̍ ca mayaska̱rāya̍ ca̱ nama̍ḥ śi̱vāya̍ ca śi̱vata̍rāya ca
159.d: नमो̍ वृ̱क्षेभ्यो̱ हरि̍केशेभ्यो̱ नम̍स्ता̱राय̍ नम̍ः श̱म्भवे̍ च मयो̱भवे̍ च̱ नम̍ः शङ्क̱राय̍ च मयस्क̱राय̍ च̱ नम̍ः शि̱वाय̍ च शि̱वत̍राय च

160.s: (6) nama̱ḥ pāryā̍ya cāvā̱ryā̍ya ca̱ nama̍ḥ pra̱tara̍ṇāya cotta̱raṇāya ca nama̍stī̱rthyā̍ya ca̱ kūlyā̍ya ca̱ nama̱ḥ śaṣpyā̍ya ca̱ phenyā̍ya ca
160.d: (6) नम̱ः पार्या̍य चावा̱र्या̍य च̱ नम̍ः प्र̱तर̍णाय चोत्त̱रणाय च नम̍स्ती̱र्थ्या̍य च̱ कूल्या̍य च̱ नम̱ः शष्प्या̍य च̱ फेन्या̍य च

160.s: nama̍ḥ sika̱tyā̍ya ca pravā̱hyā̍ya ca̱ nama̍ḥ kim̐śi̱lāya̍ ca kṣaya̱ṇāya̍ ca nama̍ḥ kapa̱rdine̍ ca pula̱stine̍ ca̱ nama̍ iri̱ṇyā̍ya ca prapa̱thyā̍ya ca
160.d: नम̍ः सिक̱त्या̍य च प्रवा̱ह्या̍य च̱ नम̍ः किम्̐शि̱लाय̍ च क्षय̱णाय̍ च नम̍ः कप̱र्दिने̍ च पुल̱स्तिने̍ च̱ नम̍ इरि̱ण्या̍य च प्रप̱थ्या̍य च
160.m:
Homage both to the braided-haired and to the shaven-haired, and homage both to the thousand-eyed and to him with a hundred bows;
homage both to the mountain-dweller and to Śipiviṣṭa, and homage both to the most bountiful and to the archer!

160.s: namo̱ vrajyā̍ya ca̱ goṣṭhyā̍ya ca̱ nama̱stalpyā̍ya ca̱ gehyā̍ya ca namo̱ hṛdyā̍ya ca nive̱ṣpyā̍ya ca̱ nama̍ḥ kāṭyā̍ya ca gahvare̱ṣṭhāya̍ ca
160.d: नमो̱ व्रज्या̍य च̱ गोष्ठ्या̍य च̱ नम̱स्तल्प्या̍य च̱ गेह्या̍य च नमो̱ हृद्या̍य च निवे̱ष्प्या̍य च̱ नम̍ः काट्या̍य च गह्वरे̱ष्ठाय̍ च
160.m: Homage to the one of the cattle-pen and of the cow-stall; homage to the one of the couch and of the house; / homage to the one of the heart and of the whirlpool; homage to the one of the chasm and to the dweller in the abyss.

160.s: nama̱: śuṣkyā̍ya ca harityā̍ya ca̱ nama̍: pām̐savyā̍ya ca raja̱syā̍ya ca namo̍ lopyā̍ya cola̱pyā̍ya ca̱ nama̍ ū̱rvyā̍ya ca̱ sūrmyā̍ya ca
160.d: नम̱: शुष्क्या̍य च हरित्या̍य च̱ नम̍: पाम्̐सव्या̍य च रज̱स्या̍य च नमो̍ लोप्या̍य चोल̱प्या̍य च̱ नम̍ ऊ̱र्व्या̍य च̱ सूर्म्या̍य च
160.m: Homage to the one of the dry and of the green; homage to the one of the dust and of the mist; / homage to the one of the rough ground and of the reed-thicket; homage to the one of the wide earth and of the fair earth.

160.s: nama̍: pa̱rṇyā̍ya ca parṇaśa̱dāya̍ ca̱ nama̍ udguramā̍ṇāya cābhighna̱te ca̍ nama̍ ākhida̱te ca̍ prakhida̱te ca̱ nama̍ iṣukṛdbhyo̍ dhanuṣkṛdbhya̍śca vo̱ nama̍: namo̍ va: kiri̱kebhyo̍ de̱vānā̱m̐ hṛda̍yebhyo̱ namo̍ vicinva̱tkebhyo̱ namo̍ vikṣiṇa̱tkebhyo̱ nama̍ ānirha̱tebhya̍:
160.d: नम̍: प̱र्ण्या̍य च पर्णश̱दाय̍ च̱ नम̍ उद्गुरमा̍णाय चाभिघ्न̱ते च̍ नम̍ आखिद̱ते च̍ प्रखिद̱ते च̱ नम̍ इषुकृद्भ्यो̍ धनुष्कृद्भ्य̍श्च वो̱ नम̍: नमो̍ व: किरि̱केभ्यो̍ दे̱वाना̱म्̐ हृद̍येभ्यो̱ नमो̍ विचिन्व̱त्केभ्यो̱ नमो̍ विक्षिण̱त्केभ्यो̱ नम̍ आनिर्ह̱तेभ्य̍:
160.m: Homage to the leaf and to the falling of leaves; homage to the brandisher [of weapons] and to the striker; / homage to the dragger and to the violent dragger; homage to you arrow-makers and bow-makers; / homage to you, his sparklers, the hearts of the gods; homage to the discerners; homage to the destroyers; homage to the uprooters.

161.s: (7) drāpe̱ andha̍saspate̱ dari̍dra̱ nīla̍lohita āsā̍ṃ pra̱jānā̍me̱ṣāṃ pa̍śū̱nāṃ mā bhermā roṅmo ca̍ na̱: kiñca̱nāma̍mat
161.d: (7) द्रापे̱ अन्ध̍सस्पते̱ दरि̍द्र̱ नील̍लोहित आसा̍ं प्र̱जाना̍मे̱षां प̍शू̱नां मा भेर्मा रोङ्मो च̍ न̱: किञ्च̱नाम̍मत्
161.m: O runner, o lord of nourishment, o wandering one, o blue-red one! / Do not terrify these offspring, these cattle of ours, nor let them fall sick, and let none among us be afflicted.

161.s: i̱mā ru̱drāya̍ ta̱vase̍ kapa̱rdine̍ kṣa̱yadvī̍rāya̱ prabha̍rāmahe ma̱tī: yathā̱ śamasa̍d dvi̱pade̱ catu̍ṣpade̱ viśva̍ṃ pu̱ṣṭaṃ grāme̍ a̱sminna̍nātu̱ram
161.d: इ̱मा रु̱द्राय̍ त̱वसे̍ कप̱र्दिने̍ क्ष̱यद्वी̍राय̱ प्रभ̍रामहे म̱ती: यथा̱ शमस̍द् द्वि̱पदे̱ चतु̍ष्पदे̱ विश्व̍ं पु̱ष्टं ग्रामे̍ अ̱स्मिन्न̍नातु̱रम्
161.m: These thoughts we bring forth for the mighty Rudra with braided hair, who rules over heroes, / that there may be welfare for our two-footed and four-footed creatures, and all may be thriving and free from sickness in this village.

161.s: yā te̍ rudra śi̱vā ta̱nū: śi̱vā vi̱śvāhā̍ bheṣa̱jī | śi̱vā ru̱tasya̍ bheṣa̱jī tayā̍ no mṛḍa jī̱vase̍
161.d: या ते̍ रुद्र शि̱वा त̱नू: शि̱वा वि̱श्वाहा̍ भेष̱जी । शि̱वा रु̱तस्य̍ भेष̱जी तया̍ नो मृड जी̱वसे̍
161.m: That body of yours, o Rudra, which is auspicious, auspicious at all times as a medicine, / auspicious as the remedy for what is harmed, with that be gracious to us that we may live.

161.s: pari̍ ṇo he̱tī ru̱drasya̍ vṛjyā̱t pari̍ tve̱ṣasya̍ durma̱tirma̱hīgā̍t ava̍ sthi̱rā ma̱ghava̍dbhyastanuṣva mīḍhva̍sto̱kāya̱ tana̍yāya mṛḍa
161.d: परि̍ णो हे̱ती रु̱द्रस्य̍ वृज्या̱त् परि̍ त्वे̱षस्य̍ दुर्म̱तिर्म̱हीगा̍त् अव̍ स्थि̱रा म̱घव̍द्भ्यस्तनुष्व मीढ्व̍स्तो̱काय̱ तन̍याय मृड
161.m: May the missile of Rudra bypass us; may the great displeasure of the fiery one bypass us; / loosen your taut [weapons] away from our liberal patrons; o bountiful one, be gracious to our children and descendants.

161.s: mīḍhu̍ṣṭama̱ śiva̍tama śi̱vo na̍: su̱manā̍ bhava pa̱ra̱me vṛ̱kṣa āyu̍dhaṃ ni̱dhāya̱ kṛtti̱ṃ vasā̍na̱ āca̍ra̱ pinā̍ka̱ṃ bibhra̱dāga̍hi
161.d: मीढु̍ष्टम̱ शिव̍तम शि̱वो न̍: सु̱मना̍ भव प̱र̱मे वृ̱क्ष आयु̍धं नि̱धाय̱ कृत्ति̱ं वसा̍न̱ आच̍र̱ पिना̍क̱ं बिभ्र̱दाग̍हि
161.m: O most bountiful, most auspicious one, be auspicious and well-disposed to us. / Having deposited your weapon upon the highest tree, clad in a skin, go about; bearing the Pināka, come hither.

161.s: viki̍ridra̱ vilo̍hita̱ nama̍ste astu bhagava: | yāste̍ sa̱hasra̍m̐ he̱tayo̱'nyama̱smanniva̍pantu̱ tā:
161.d: विकि̍रिद्र̱ विलो̍हित̱ नम̍स्ते अस्तु भगव: । यास्ते̍ स̱हस्र̍म्̐ हे̱तयो̱ऽन्यम̱स्मन्निव̍पन्तु̱ ता:
161.m: O scatterer, o deep-red one, homage be to you, o bountiful lord! / Those thousands of missiles that are yours, let them strike down someone other than us.

161.s: sa̱hasrā̍ṇi sahasra̱śo bā̱hvostava̍ he̱taya̍: | tāsā̱mīśā̍no bhagava: parā̱cīnā̱ mukhā̍ kṛdhi
161.d: स̱हस्रा̍णि सहस्र̱शो बा̱ह्वोस्तव̍ हे̱तय̍: । तासा̱मीशा̍नो भगव: परा̱चीना̱ मुखा̍ कृधि
161.m: Thousands upon thousands are the missiles in your two arms; / as their lord, o bountiful one, turn their points away.

161.s: asa̍ṅkhyātā sa̱hasrā̍ṇi̱ ye ru̱drā adhi̱ bhūmyā̍m | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: अस̍ङ्ख्याता स̱हस्रा̍णि̱ ये रु̱द्रा अधि̱ भूम्या̍म् । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m: Innumerably thousands are the Rudras who are upon the earth; / a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows.

161.s: a̱smin ma̍ha̱tya̍rṇa̱ve'ntari̍kṣe bha̱vā adhi̍ | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: अ̱स्मिन् म̍ह̱त्य̍र्ण̱वेऽन्तरि̍क्षे भ̱वा अधि̍ । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m: In this great ocean, in mid-air, the Bhavas who dwell; / a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows.

161.s: nīla̍grīvā: śiti̱kaṇṭhā̱ diva̍m̐ ru̱drā upa̍śritā: | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: नील̍ग्रीवा: शिति̱कण्ठा̱ दिव̍म्̐ रु̱द्रा उप̍श्रिता: । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m:
The blue-necked, white-throated Rudras who have resorted to heaven; / a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows.

The blue-necked, white-throated Śarvas who dwell beneath upon the earth; / a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows.

161.s: nīla̍grīvā: śiti̱kaṇṭhā̍: śa̱rvā a̱dha: kṣa̍māca̱rā: | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: नील̍ग्रीवा: शिति̱कण्ठा̍: श̱र्वा अ̱ध: क्ष̍माच̱रा: । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि

161.s: ye vṛ̱kṣeṣu̍ śa̱ṣpiñja̍rā̱ nīla̍grīvā vilo̍hitā: | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: ये वृ̱क्षेषु̍ श̱ष्पिञ्ज̍रा̱ नील̍ग्रीवा विलो̍हिता: । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m: Those who are in the trees, yellow-green as young grass, blue-necked, deep-red; / a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows.

161.s: ye bhū̱tānā̱madhi̍patayo viśi̱khāsa̍: kapa̱rdina̍: | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: ये भू̱ताना̱मधि̍पतयो विशि̱खास̍: कप̱र्दिन̍: । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m: Those who are lords of spirits, bald and with braided hair; / a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows.

161.s: ye pa̱thāṃ pa̍thi̱rakṣa̍ya̱ aila̍bṛdā ā̱yuryudha̍: | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: ये प̱थां प̍थि̱रक्ष̍य̱ ऐल̍बृदा आ̱युर्युध̍: । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m: Those who, guarding the paths, bearing provisions, fight for life— / a thousand leagues away we unbend their bows.

161.s: ye tī̱rthāni̍ pra̱cara̍nti sṛ̱kāha̍stā niṣa̱ṅgiṇa̍: | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: ये ती̱र्थानि̍ प्र̱चर̍न्ति सृ̱काह̍स्ता निष̱ङ्गिण̍: । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m: Those who wander along the fords, dagger in hand, equipped with quivers— / a thousand leagues away we unbend their bows.

161.s: ye'nne̍ṣu vivi̱dhyanti̱ pātre̍ṣu̱ piba̍to̱ janā̍n | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
161.d: येऽन्ने̍षु विवि̱ध्यन्ति̱ पात्रे̍षु̱ पिब̍तो̱ जना̍न् । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
161.m: Those who pierce people in their foods and while drinking from their cups— / a thousand leagues away we unbend their bows.

161.s:
ya e̱tāva̍ntaśca̱ bhūyā̍ṃm̐saśca̱ diśo̍ ru̱drā vi̍tasthi̱re | teṣā̍ṃm̐ sahasrayoja̱ne'va̱ dhanvā̍ni tanmasi
adhyāyaḥ
161.d:
य ए̱ताव̍न्तश्च̱ भूया̍ंम्̐सश्च̱ दिशो̍ रु̱द्रा वि̍तस्थि̱रे । तेषा̍ंम्̐ सहस्रयोज̱नेऽव̱ धन्वा̍नि तन्मसि
अध्यायः
161.m: As many Rudras as these and more who have settled throughout the quarters— / a thousand leagues away we unbend their bows.

161.s:
64;
namo̍'stu ru̱drebhyo̱ ye di̱vi yeṣā̍ṃ va̱rṣamiṣa̍vaḥ tebhyo̱ daśa̱ prācī̱rdaśa̍ dakṣi̱ṇā daśa̍ pra̱tīcī̱rdaśodī̍cī̱rdaśo̱rdhvāḥ tebhyo̱ namo̍ astu̱ te no̍ mṛḷayantu̱ te no̍'vantu te yaṃ dvi̱ṣmo yaśca̍ no̱ dveṣṭi̱ tame̍ṣā̱ṃ jambhe̍ dadhmaḥ namo̍'stu ru̱drebhyo̱ ye'ntarvi̍kṣe̱ yeṣā̱ṃ vāta̱ iṣa̍vaḥ tebhyo̱ daśa̱ prācī̱rdaśa̍ dakṣi̱ṇā daśa̍ pra̱tīcī̱rdaśodī̍cī̱rdaśo̱rdhvāḥ tebhyo̱ namo̍ astu̱ te no̍ mṛḷayantu̱ te no̍'vantu te yaṃ dvi̱ṣmo yaśca̍ no̱ dveṣṭi̱ tame̍ṣā̱ṃ jambhe̍ dadhmaḥ namo̍'stu ru̱drebhyo̱ ye pṛ̍thi̱vyāṃ yeṣā̱manna̱miṣa̍vaḥ tebhyo̱ daśa̱ prācī̱rdaśa̍ dakṣi̱ṇā daśa̍ pra̱tīcī̱rdaśodī̍cī̱rdaśo̱rdhvāḥ tebhyo̱ namo̍ astu̱ te no̍ mṛḷayantu̱ te no̍'vantu te yaṃ dvi̱ṣmo yaśca̍ no̱ dveṣṭi̱ tame̍ṣā̱ṃ jambhe̍ dadhmaḥ
(8) namaste ṣoḍaśa
namo hiraṇyabāhave pañca
nama uṣṇīṣiṇe pañca
161.d:
64;
नमो̍ऽस्तु रु̱द्रेभ्यो̱ ये दि̱वि येषा̍ं व̱र्षमिष̍वः तेभ्यो̱ दश̱ प्राची̱र्दश̍ दक्षि̱णा दश̍ प्र̱तीची̱र्दशोदी̍ची̱र्दशो̱र्ध्वाः तेभ्यो̱ नमो̍ अस्तु̱ ते नो̍ मृऌअयन्तु̱ ते नो̍ऽवन्तु ते यं द्वि̱ष्मो यश्च̍ नो̱ द्वेष्टि̱ तमे̍षा̱ं जम्भे̍ दध्मः नमो̍ऽस्तु रु̱द्रेभ्यो̱ येऽन्तर्वि̍क्षे̱ येषा̱ं वात̱ इष̍वः तेभ्यो̱ दश̱ प्राची̱र्दश̍ दक्षि̱णा दश̍ प्र̱तीची̱र्दशोदी̍ची̱र्दशो̱र्ध्वाः तेभ्यो̱ नमो̍ अस्तु̱ ते नो̍ मृऌअयन्तु̱ ते नो̍ऽवन्तु ते यं द्वि̱ष्मो यश्च̍ नो̱ द्वेष्टि̱ तमे̍षा̱ं जम्भे̍ दध्मः नमो̍ऽस्तु रु̱द्रेभ्यो̱ ये पृ̍थि̱व्यां येषा̱मन्न̱मिष̍वः तेभ्यो̱ दश̱ प्राची̱र्दश̍ दक्षि̱णा दश̍ प्र̱तीची̱र्दशोदी̍ची̱र्दशो̱र्ध्वाः तेभ्यो̱ नमो̍ अस्तु̱ ते नो̍ मृऌअयन्तु̱ ते नो̍ऽवन्तु ते यं द्वि̱ष्मो यश्च̍ नो̱ द्वेष्टि̱ तमे̍षा̱ं जम्भे̍ दध्मः
(8) नमस्ते षोडश
नमो हिरण्यबाहवे पञ्च
नम उष्णीषिणे पञ्च
161.m: Homage be to the Rudras who are in heaven, whose arrows are the rain! / To them ten [fingers] eastward, ten southward, ten westward, ten northward, ten upward! / Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they protect us! / Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place into their jaws! / Homage be to the Rudras who are in mid-air, whose arrows are the wind! / To them ten [fingers] eastward, ten southward, ten westward, ten northward, ten upward! / Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they protect us! / Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place into their jaws! / Homage be to the Rudras who are on earth, whose arrows are food! / To them ten [fingers] eastward, ten southward, ten westward, ten northward, ten upward! / Homage be to them! May they be gracious to us, may they protect us! / Whom we hate and who hates us, him we place into their jaws!

161.s:
namastakṣabhyaḥ pañca
namo jyeṣṭhāya pañca
namaḥ sutyāya pañca
namaḥ pāryāya pañca
drāpe andhasaspata aṣṭādaśa
161.d:
नमस्तक्षभ्यः पञ्च
नमो ज्येष्ठाय पञ्च
नमः सुत्याय पञ्च
नमः पार्याय पञ्च
द्रापे अन्धसस्पत अष्टादश
161.m: “Homage to you”, sixteen [verses]. 16. “Homage to the golden-armed”, five. 5. “Homage to the turbaned”, five. 5. “Homage to the carpenters”, five. 5. / “Homage to the eldest”, five. 5. “Homage to him who is in the stream”, five. 5. “Homage to him who is on the further shore”, five. 5. “O chaser, lord of food”, eighteen. 18. In eight anuvākas, sixty-four. 64. / Thus ends the seventeenth adhyāya in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā. 17.

161.s: aṣṭānuvākeṣu catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ
161.d: अष्टानुवाकेषु चतुःषष्टिः

162.s: aśma̱nnūrja̱ṃ parva̍te śiśriyā̱ṇāma̱dbhya oṣa̍dhībhyo̱ vana̱spati̍bhyo̱ adhi̱ saṃbhṛ̍ta̱ṃ paya̍ḥ tāṃ na̱ iṣa̱mūrja̍ṃ dhatta marutaḥ sam̐rarā̱ṇā aśma̍m̐ste kṣunmayi̍ ta̱ ūrgyaṃ dvi̱ṣmastaṃ te̱ śugṛ̍cchatu
162.d: अश्म̱न्नूर्ज̱ं पर्व̍ते शिश्रिया̱णाम̱द्भ्य ओष̍धीभ्यो̱ वन̱स्पति̍भ्यो̱ अधि̱ संभृ̍त̱ं पय̍ः तां न̱ इष̱मूर्ज̍ं धत्त मरुतः सम्̐ररा̱णा अश्म̍म्̐स्ते क्षुन्मयि̍ त̱ ऊर्ग्यं द्वि̱ष्मस्तं ते̱ शुगृ̍च्छतु
162.m: In the stone [lies] the refreshment resting in the mountain, the milk collected from the waters, the plants, and the trees. / Confer upon us that sustenance and refreshment, O Maruts, acting in unison. In the stone is your hunger; in me is your refreshment; whom we hate, let your distress reach him!

162.s: i̱mā me̍ agna̱ iṣṭa̍kā dhe̱nava̍ḥ santvekā̍ ca̱ daśa̍ ca̱ daśa̍ ca śa̱taṃ ca̍ śa̱taṃ ca̍ sa̱hasra̍ṃ ca sa̱hasra̍ṃ cāyu̱taṃ cā̍yu̱taṃ ca̍ niyu̱taṃ ca̍ niyu̱taṃ ca
162.d: इ̱मा मे̍ अग्न̱ इष्ट̍का धे̱नव̍ः सन्त्वेका̍ च̱ दश̍ च̱ दश̍ च श̱तं च̍ श̱तं च̍ स̱हस्र̍ं च स̱हस्र̍ं चायु̱तं चा̍यु̱तं च̍ नियु̱तं च̍ नियु̱तं च
162.m: May these bricks be milch-cows for me, O Agni: one and ten, and ten and a hundred, and a hundred / and a thousand, and a thousand and ten thousand, and ten thousand and a hundred thousand, and a hundred thousand

162.s: arbu̱daṃ ca̱ nya̍rbudaṃ ca samu̱draśca̱ madhya̱ṃ cānta̍śca parārdhaśca̍ e̱tā me̍ agna̱ iṣṭa̍kā dhe̱nava̍ḥ santva̱mutrā̱muṣmi̍m̐llo̱ke
162.d: अर्बु̱दं च̱ न्य̍र्बुदं च समु̱द्रश्च̱ मध्य̱ं चान्त̍श्च परार्धश्च̍ ए̱ता मे̍ अग्न̱ इष्ट̍का धे̱नव̍ः सन्त्व̱मुत्रा̱मुष्मि̍म्̐ल्लो̱के
162.m: and ten million, and a hundred million, and the ocean, and the middle, and the end, and the highest limit! / May these bricks be milch-cows for me, O Agni, yonder in that world!

162.s: ṛ̱tava̍ stha ṛtā̱vṛdha̍ ṛtu̱ṣṭhā stha̍ ṛtā̱vṛdha̍ḥ ghṛ̱ta̱ścyuto̍ madhu̱ścyuto̍ vi̱rājo̱ nāma̍ kāma̱dughā̱ akṣī̍yamāṇāḥ
162.d: ऋ̱तव̍ स्थ ऋता̱वृध̍ ऋतु̱ष्ठा स्थ̍ ऋता̱वृध̍ः घृ̱त̱श्च्युतो̍ मधु̱श्च्युतो̍ वि̱राजो̱ नाम̍ काम̱दुघा̱ अक्षी̍यमाणाः
162.m: You are the seasons, growing through cosmic order; you are seated in the seasons, growing through cosmic order; / dripping ghee, dripping honey, Virājs by name, granting desires, inexhaustible.

162.s: sa̱mu̱drasya̱ tvāva̍kayāgne̱ pari̍vyayāmasi | pā̱va̱ko a̱smabhya̍m̐ śi̱vo bha̍va
162.d: स̱मु̱द्रस्य̱ त्वाव̍कयाग्ने̱ परि̍व्ययामसि । पा̱व̱को अ̱स्मभ्य̍म्̐ शि̱वो भ̍व
162.m: With water-reed from the ocean we envelop you, O Agni; / as the purifier, be auspicious to us!

162.s: hi̱masya̍ tvā ja̱rāyu̍ṇāgne̱ pari̍vyayāmasi | pā̱va̱ko a̱smabhya̍m̐ śi̱vo bha̍va
162.d: हि̱मस्य̍ त्वा ज̱रायु̍णाग्ने̱ परि̍व्ययामसि । पा̱व̱को अ̱स्मभ्य̍म्̐ शि̱वो भ̍व
162.m: With the caul of snow we envelop you, O Agni; / as the purifier, be auspicious to us!

162.s: upa̱ jmannupa̍ veta̱se'va̍tara na̱dīṣvā agne̍ pi̱ttama̱pāma̍si ma̱ṇḍūki̱ tābhi̱rāga̍hi̱ semaṃ no̍ ya̱jñaṃ pā̍va̱kavarṇam̐ śi̱vaṃ kṛ̍dhi
162.d: उप̱ ज्मन्नुप̍ वेत̱सेऽव̍तर न̱दीष्वा अग्ने̍ पि̱त्तम̱पाम̍सि म̱ण्डूकि̱ ताभि̱राग̍हि̱ सेमं नो̍ य̱ज्ञं पा̍व̱कवर्णम्̐ शि̱वं कृ̍धि
162.m: Descend near to the earth, down to the reed, into the rivers! / You are the bile of the waters, O Agni; come together with those female frogs, and make this sacrifice of ours purifying in color and auspicious!

162.s: a̱pāmi̱daṃ nyaya̍nam̐ samu̱drasya̍ nive̱śana̍m a̱nyām̐ste̍ a̱smatta̍pantu he̱taya̍: pā̱va̱ko a̱smabhya̍m̐ śi̱vo bha̍va
162.d: अ̱पामि̱दं न्यय̍नम्̐ समु̱द्रस्य̍ निवे̱शन̍म् अ̱न्याम्̐स्ते̍ अ̱स्मत्त̍पन्तु हे̱तय̍: पा̱व̱को अ̱स्मभ्य̍म्̐ शि̱वो भ̍व
162.m: This is the descending-place of the waters, the dwelling of the ocean. / Let your missiles burn someone other than us; as the purifier, be auspicious to us!

162.s: agne̍ pāvaka ro̱ciṣā̍ ma̱ndrayā̍ deva ji̱hvayā̍ | ā de̱vānva̍kṣi̱ yakṣi̍ ca
162.d: अग्ने̍ पावक रो̱चिषा̍ म̱न्द्रया̍ देव जि̱ह्वया̍ । आ दे̱वान्व̍क्षि̱ यक्षि̍ च
162.m: O Agni, purifying with your radiant, delightful tongue, O god, / bring the gods hither and sacrifice [to them]!

162.s: sa na̍: pāvaka dīdi̱vo'gne̍ de̱vām̐2 ihāva̍ha | upa̍ ya̱jñam̐ ha̱viśca̍ na:
162.d: स न̍: पावक दीदि̱वोऽग्ने̍ दे̱वाम्̐2 इहाव̍ह । उप̍ य̱ज्ञम्̐ ह̱विश्च̍ न:
162.m: So, shining brightly, O purifying Agni, bring the gods hither to us, / to our sacrifice and our oblation!

162.s: pā̱va̱kayā̱ yaści̱taya̍ntyā kṛ̱pā kṣāma̍n ru̱ruca̍ u̱ṣaso̱ na bhā̱nunā̍ tūrva̱nna yāma̱nneta̍śasya̱ nū raṇa̱ ā yo ghṛ̱ṇe na ta̍tṛṣā̱ṇo a̱jara̍:
162.d: पा̱व̱कया̱ यश्चि̱तय̍न्त्या कृ̱पा क्षाम̍न् रु̱रुच̍ उ̱षसो̱ न भा̱नुना̍ तूर्व̱न्न याम̱न्नेत̍शस्य̱ नू रण̱ आ यो घृ̱णे न त̍तृषा̱णो अ̱जर̍:
162.m: Who has shone forth on earth with purifying, inspiring beauty as with the light of dawn, / overcoming in his course like Etaśa in battle, who, unaging, thirsts not in the burning heat.

162.s: nama̍ste hara̍se śo̱ciṣe̱ nama̍ste astva̱rciṣe̍ a̱nyām̐ste̍ a̱smatta̍pantu he̱taya̍: pā̱va̱ko a̱smabhya̍m̐ śi̱vo bha̍va nṛ̱ṣade̱ veḍa̍psu̱ṣade̱ veḍ ba̍rhi̱ṣade̱ veḍ va̍na̱sade̱ veṭ sva̍rvide̱ veṭ
162.d: नम̍स्ते हर̍से शो̱चिषे̱ नम̍स्ते अस्त्व̱र्चिषे̍ अ̱न्याम्̐स्ते̍ अ̱स्मत्त̍पन्तु हे̱तय̍: पा̱व̱को अ̱स्मभ्य̍म्̐ शि̱वो भ̍व नृ̱षदे̱ वेड̍प्सु̱षदे̱ वेड् ब̍र्हि̱षदे̱ वेड् व̍न̱सदे̱ वेट् स्व̍र्विदे̱ वेट्
162.m: Homage to your heat, to your glow! Homage be to your flame! / Let your missiles burn someone other than us; as the purifier, be auspicious to us! / Hail to the one who sits among men! Hail to the one who sits in the waters! Hail to the one who sits on the barhis! Hail to the one who sits in the wood! Hail to the finder of heaven!

162.s: ye de̱vā de̱vānā̍m̐ ya̱jñiyā̍ ya̱jñiyā̍nām̐ saṃvatsa̱rīṇa̱mupa̍ bhā̱gamāsa̍te ahu̍tādo ha̱viṣo̍ ya̱jñe a̱smintsva̱yaṃ pi̍bantu̱ madhu̍no ghṛ̱tasya̍
162.d: ये दे̱वा दे̱वाना̍म्̐ य̱ज्ञिया̍ य̱ज्ञिया̍नाम्̐ संवत्स̱रीण̱मुप̍ भा̱गमास̍ते अहु̍तादो ह̱विषो̍ य̱ज्ञे अ̱स्मिन्त्स्व̱यं पि̍बन्तु̱ मधु̍नो घृ̱तस्य̍
162.m: Those gods who, worthy of sacrifice among the gods, attend the yearly portion of those worthy of sacrifice, / eating what is not offered into fire, let them personally drink of the sweet ghee in this sacrifice.

162.s: ye de̱vā de̱veṣvadhi̍ de̱vatvamāya̱nye bra̱hmaṇa̍: pu̱ra e̱tāro̍ a̱sya yebhyo̱ na ṛ̱te pava̍te̱ dhāma̱ kiñca̱na na te di̱vo na pṛ̍thi̱vyā adhi̍ snuṣu̍
162.d: ये दे̱वा दे̱वेष्वधि̍ दे̱वत्वमाय̱न्ये ब्र̱ह्मण̍: पु̱र ए̱तारो̍ अ̱स्य येभ्यो̱ न ऋ̱ते पव̍ते̱ धाम̱ किञ्च̱न न ते दि̱वो न पृ̍थि̱व्या अधि̍ स्नुषु̍
162.m: Those gods who attained divinity among the gods, who march in front of this sacred formulation, / without whom no domain is purified, they are not from heaven, nor upon the plateaus of earth.

162.s:
prā̱ṇa̱dā a̍pāna̱dā vyā̍na̱dā varco̱dā va̍rivo̱dā: a̱nyām̐ste̍ a̱smatta̍pantu he̱taya̍: pā̱va̱ko a̱smabhya̍m̐ śi̱vo bha̍va
(1)
162.d:
प्रा̱ण̱दा अ̍पान̱दा व्या̍न̱दा वर्चो̱दा व̍रिवो̱दा: अ̱न्याम्̐स्ते̍ अ̱स्मत्त̍पन्तु हे̱तय̍: पा̱व̱को अ̱स्मभ्य̍म्̐ शि̱वो भ̍व
(1)
162.m: Giver of in-breath, giver of out-breath, giver of diffused breath, giver of luster, giver of wide room! / Let your missiles burn someone other than us; as the purifier, be auspicious to us!

163.s: a̱gnisti̱gmena̍ śo̱ciṣā̱ yāsa̍dviśva̱ṃ nyatri̍ṇam | a̱gnirno̍ vanute ra̱yim
163.d: अ̱ग्निस्ति̱ग्मेन̍ शो̱चिषा̱ यास̍द्विश्व̱ं न्यत्रि̍णम् । अ̱ग्निर्नो̍ वनुते र̱यिम्
163.m: May Agni with his sharp flame drive away every devourer; / Agni wins wealth for us.

163.s: ya i̱mā viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ juhva̱dṛṣi̱rhotā̱ nyasī̍datpi̱tā na̍: sa ā̱śiṣā̱ dravi̍ṇami̱cchamā̍na: prathama̱cchadava̍rām̐2 āvi̍veśa
163.d: य इ̱मा विश्वा̱ भुव̍नानि̱ जुह्व̱दृषि̱र्होता̱ न्यसी̍दत्पि̱ता न̍: स आ̱शिषा̱ द्रवि̍णमि̱च्छमा̍न: प्रथम̱च्छदव̍राम्̐2 आवि̍वेश
163.m: The seer, the Hotṛ, our father, who, sacrificing all these worlds, sat down— / he, seeking wealth through prayer, cloaking what was first, entered into the later ones.
